units.source: 50% chance: You failed to get the named relic and have to fight the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}ancient dead{/#4}.

Contracts are missions that can be accepted in {#1}Settlements{/#1}. Completing a contract will reward your company with crowns, {#2}Renown{/#2}, and better {#3}Relations{/#3} with the settlement or the noble house that offered the contract. However, failing to fulfill a contract lowers your company's local {#4}Relations{/#4} and the company's {#5}Renown{/#5}.
units.zh: 委托是在{#1}聚落{/#1}中可以接取的任务。完成后，战团会获得克朗、{#2}声望{/#2}，并改善与发布委托的聚落或贵族家族的{#3}关系{/#3}。未能履约则会降低当地{#4}关系{/#4}和战团{#5}声望{/#5}。

units.source: You may only have one active contract at a time. The crowns reward increases with your company's {#1}Renown{/#1}. Some contracts, such as the noble houses contracts, are only available with a certain level of {#2}Renown{/#2}.
units.zh: 同一时间只能执行一份委托。克朗报酬随战团{#1}声望{/#1}提高而增加。某些委托，例如贵族家族的委托，只有达到一定{#2}声望{/#2}后才能接取。

units.source: Contract targets can be identified with a golden coin on the {#1}Global Map{/#1}.
units.zh: 委托目标会在{#1}世界地图{/#1}上以金币图标标记。

units.source: NOTE: the information provided in this section is primarily based on Negotiation Mechanics {#1}Steam post{/#1}.
units.zh: 说明：本节资料主要依据这篇介绍谈判机制的{#1}Steam 帖子{/#1}。

units.source: Before taking a contract, it is possible to haggle for better pay. However, each haggling attempt will worsen {#1}Relations{/#1} by 0.5 points with the settlement if you don't have the {#2}Negotiator{/#2} follower.
units.zh: 接取委托前，可以讨价还价以争取更高报酬。不过，若没有{#2}谈判专家{/#2}随从，每次议价都会使与该聚落的{#1}关系{/#1}下降 0.5 点。

units.source: When you start negotiating, a hidden variable called Annoyance determines how things will go. Every time you haggle, you gain a random amount of Annoyance between 3 and 6. This number is a float so that you can draw fractional numbers like 4.5. If your Annoyance hits 9 or higher, you are kicked out and take a substantial reputation penalty with the person trying to hire you. You accumulate Annoyance whether the haggle attempt succeeds or fails. Having the {#1}Negotiator{/#1} cuts the annoyance gain in half, i.e., to 1.5 - 3 per haggle.
units.zh: 开始谈判后，隐藏数值“恼怒值”决定议价的走向。每次议价都会随机增加 3 至 6 点恼怒值；它可以带有小数，例如 4.5。恼怒值达到 9 或更高时，雇主会赶你走，你与雇主的关系也会大幅恶化。无论议价成功还是失败，都会累积恼怒值。{#1}谈判专家{/#1}会使每次增加的数值减半，即每次增加 1.5 - 3 点。

units.source: The odds of a haggle failing are equal to your Annoyance * 0.1. You collect Annoyance for haggling BEFORE rolling. Thus, your first haggle attempt will have a failure rate of somewhere between 30-60%, with an average failure rate of 45%.
units.zh: 议价失败的概率等于恼怒值 * 0.1。游戏先增加本次议价的恼怒值，再进行判定。因此，第一次议价的失败率介于 30-60%，平均为 45%。

units.source: If you ask for more pay, the value of the contract increases between 4-11%. The game tries to increase all forms of compensation by this amount (e.g., completion pay, advance pay, pay per head), but because of rounding issues, you sometimes get less.
units.zh: 要求提高总报酬时，委托价值会增加 4-11%。游戏会尝试按这一幅度提高所有付款项目，例如完工报酬、预付款和人头赏金；但受取整影响，实际增幅有时会略低。

units.source: If you ask for payment in advance, the game subtracts 25% from your completion and per-head pay and adds it to the advance pay. Because of rounding issues, you usually lose money overall. The {#1}Negotiator{/#1} increases the proportion of your pay that can be asked for in advance.
units.zh: 要求更多预付款时，游戏会从完工报酬和人头赏金中各扣除 25%，转入预付款。由于取整，总报酬通常会略有减少。{#1}谈判专家{/#1}可以提高允许预先领取的报酬比例。

units.source: If you ask for more pay per head, the game subtracts 25% from completion and advance pay and adds it to the per-head pay. You might lose money due to rounding. You could lose even more if you don't collect the maximum number of heads.
units.zh: 要求提高人头赏金时，游戏会从完工报酬和预付款中各扣除 25%，转入人头赏金。取整可能导致总报酬减少；若未能拿满人头数量，损失还会更大。

units.source: Contracts will ask for more or less the same tasks to be completed. However when, where and who you fight may vary widely. Contract difficultly is measured with skulls. More skulls means more danger, but a better pay.
units.zh: 同类委托要求完成的任务大体相似，但交战的时间、地点和敌人可能相差很大。委托难度以骷髅数量表示，骷髅越多，危险越大，报酬也越高。

units.source: Contract types that involve destroying a location replace existing enemy forces for the new one scaled to the contract difficulty. For example, a coven full of {#1}Necrosavants{/#1} can have them replaced by {#2}Ancient Auxiliary{/#2} if the contract difficulty is low. One or two skull contracts can overwrite {#3}Named Items{/#3} that a location may be holding.
units.zh: 要求摧毁地点的委托，会用按委托难度生成的新敌军替换该地原有守军。例如，原本驻有大量{#1}死灵剑士{/#1}的据点，在低难度委托下可能改由{#2}古代辅兵{/#2}把守。一颗或两颗骷髅的委托还可能覆盖该地点原有的{#3}名贵装备{/#3}。

units.source: Defend a settlement against a single or multiple waves of enemies raiding their {#1}Attached Locations{/#1}.
units.zh: 保护聚落，抵御一波或多波袭击其{#1}附属地点{/#1}的敌人。

units.source: You will face either {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Brigands{/#4} or {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Zombies{/#8}, whichever has a closer distance to the settlement.
20% chance: A kidnapping takes place and you are expected to go after them.
units.zh: 20% 概率：发生绑架，你需要追赶绑匪。

units.source: 20% chance: The local militia wants to take your orders while defending the settlement.
units.zh: 20% 概率：当地民兵希望在保卫聚落时听从你的指挥。

units.source: You are more likely to be attacked by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Zombies{/#4} during the {#5}Undead Scourge{/#5}.
Letting them destroy attached locations will get you only part of the pay.
units.zh: 若放任敌人摧毁附属地点，就只能拿到部分报酬。

units.source: The settlement will get the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Raided{/#4} settlement situation if you fail to protect the attached location or fail the contract.
units.zh: 若未能保住附属地点，或委托失败，聚落会陷入{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}遭到劫掠{/#4}状况。

units.source: You can use nearby patrols to fight attackers but still need to take part to the battle or it will be counted as fail.
units.zh: 可以借助附近巡逻队对付袭击者，但你仍须亲自参战，否则会被判定为失败。

units.source: Enemy parties spawning in nearby camps belong to specific enemy faction so it can take them some time to arrive.
units.zh: 袭击部队会从附近属于相应敌对势力的营地生成，因此可能需要一段时间才会抵达。

units.source: You will face either {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Orcs{/#4} or {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Goblins{/#8}, whichever has a closer distance to the settlement.
25% chance: The local militia wants to take your orders while defending the settlement.
units.zh: 25% 概率：当地民兵希望在保卫聚落时听从你的指挥。

units.source: Completing this contract removes the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Marauding Greenskins{/#4} settlement situation.
5% chance: The cargo starts moving and is an evil artifact. ({#1}Evil Artifact{/#1})
units.zh: 5% 概率：货物开始自行活动，原来是一件邪恶器物。（{#1}邪恶遗物{/#1}）

units.source: 10% chance: You are stopped by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Mercenaries{/#4}, with option to surrender goods or fight. ({#5}Hostile Mercenaries{/#5})
5% chance: Cargo is stolen by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Brigands{/#4} who left foot-marks to their lair. Track them and destroy their lair.
units.zh: 5% 概率：货物被{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}强盗{/#4}偷走，他们留下了通往巢穴的足迹。追踪他们并摧毁巢穴。

units.source: You are expected to find a location in a region in a certain direction.
units.zh: 前往指定方向的某片区域，寻找目标地点。

units.source: You often get directions on your way if you fail to find it.
units.zh: 若迟迟找不到，途中通常会有人提供方向。

units.source: 15% chance: You are approached by a man that wants to keep the location a secret if you find it. ({#1}Secret Location{/#1})
units.zh: 15% 概率：有人前来接洽，希望你找到目标后保守该地点的秘密。（{#1}秘密地点{/#1}）

units.source: 20% chance: If you took directions from an altruist you get attacked by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}brigands{/#4} at the location. ({#5}Altruists Trap{/#5})
20% chance: Bandits are visited by their leader. If you kill him there is an additional reward for his head. ({#1}Robber Baron{/#1})
units.zh: 20% 概率：强盗头目来到营地。杀死他后，可凭首级领取额外赏金。（{#1}强盗男爵{/#1}）

units.source: 50% chance: You are stopped by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}bounty hunters{/#4} that demand the surrender of the leaders head. ({#5}Hostile Mercenaries 2{/#5})
10% chance: After the battle you find a prisoner that wants to join you. ({#1}Brigand Prisoner{/#1})
units.zh: 10% 概率：战后发现一名俘虏，他希望加入战团。（{#1}强盗俘虏{/#1}）

units.source: 10% chance: After the battle you get the option to "slit their throats" or "chase them away". ({#1}Slit Throat{/#1})
units.zh: 10% 概率：战后可以选择“割断他们的喉咙”或“赶走他们”。（{#1}割喉{/#1}）

units.source: If you destroy their camp, the settlement will no longer have {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}ambushed trade routes{/#4}.
20% chance: You can choose to fight the whole camp or agree to an 1vs1 duel. ({#1}Barbarian Duel{/#1})
units.zh: 20% 概率：可以选择进攻整个营地，或同意进行 1vs1 单挑。（{#1}蛮族决斗{/#1}）

units.source: After winning the duel, barbarians will leave, completing the contract.
units.zh: 赢得决斗后，蛮族会离开，委托完成。

units.source: After losing the duel you can choose to leave the camp for extra moral reputation, but you fail the contract or destroy their camp to finish the contract, but you will lose moral reputaion.
units.zh: 决斗落败后，可以选择离开营地，提高道德声誉，但委托失败；也可以摧毁营地完成委托，但会损失道德声誉。

units.source: 20% chance: The barbarians attack you and want to raid the settlement that gave you the contract afterwards. You get double payment and extra reputation if you win. You will lose a large amount of reputation and the settlement will get the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}raided{/#4} settlement situation for 3 days if you lose this fight. ({#5}Barbarian Revenge{/#5})
units.zh: 20% 概率：蛮族主动攻击你，并打算随后劫掠发布委托的聚落。获胜可得到双倍报酬和额外声誉；落败则会大幅损失声誉，聚落还会陷入持续 3 天的{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}遭到劫掠{/#4}状况。（{#5}蛮族复仇{/#5}）

units.source: 10% chance: You can choose to hire the 1 barbarian that survived the attack. ({#1}Barbarian Survivor{/#1})
units.zh: 10% 概率：可以选择雇用袭击后幸存的 1 名蛮族。（{#1}蛮族幸存者{/#1}）

units.source: Protect a caravan until it safely arrives at its destination settlement.
units.zh: 护送商队，直到它安全抵达目的地聚落。

units.source: 5% chance: Your men ask you to take the cargo for yourself. ({#1}Valuable Cargo{/#1})
units.zh: 5% 概率：弟兄们提议把货物据为己有。（{#1}贵重货物{/#1}）

units.source: 10% chance: Caravan is stopped by noble troops, the player has the option to surrender or fight. ({#1}Stolen Goods{/#1})
units.zh: 10% 概率：商队被贵族军队拦下，玩家可以选择交出货物或战斗。（{#1}赃物{/#1}）

units.source: 5% chance: You notice a cage with a prisoner with your cargo who wants to be freed. ({#1}Mysterious Prisoner{/#1})
units.zh: 5% 概率：发现货物中有个关着囚犯的笼子，对方请求获释。（{#1}神秘囚犯{/#1}）

units.source: 10% chance: The caravan is attacked by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Necrosavant{/#4}. ({#5}Vampire Attack{/#5})
The player will lose control of movement for the duration of this mission as your company must follow the caravan.
units.zh: 护送期间，战团必须跟随商队行进，玩家无法自行控制移动。

units.source: Only food is taken care by caravans, the player still needs to pay upkeep in coins.
units.zh: 商队只负责提供食物，弟兄们的工资仍由玩家支付。

units.source: If the caravan moves through a settlement, the player can pause the game and click on it and visit the settlement to sell loot/hire new troops.
units.zh: 商队经过聚落时，可以暂停游戏，点击并进入聚落，出售战利品或招募人手。

units.source: Losing some, but not all {#1}Donkeys{/#1} will have you poorly complete the contract. You gain 50% less crowns & {#2}Relation{/#2}. You get the normal amount of {#3}Renown{/#3}.
units.zh: 若{#1}驴{/#1}有损失但未全部死亡，委托会以较差结果完成：克朗报酬和{#2}关系{/#2}提升均减少 50%，{#3}声望{/#3}奖励则不变。

units.source: If you finish this contract, the settlement will become {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}well supplied{/#4}. If you poorly complete the contract, it won't.
units.zh: 正常完成委托后，目的地聚落会获得{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}物资充足{/#4}状况；若完成结果较差，则不会获得。

units.source: Kill the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}alps{/#4} that are haunting the settlement at night.

25% chance: Your brothers have slept so well 75% of them get a good mood after defeating the alps and they lose any {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} exhausted, {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} hangover or {#7}{#8}{#9/}{/#8}{/#7} drunk status. ({#10}Good Nights Sleep{/#10})
The settlement will no longer have the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}terrifying nightmares{/#4} situation if you fulfill this contract.
Stay near the settlement and protect your employers firstborn son.
units.zh: 留在聚落附近，保护雇主的长子。

units.source: 20% chance: The {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}hexe{/#4} will be a "spider queen" and bring {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}webknecht{/#8} bodyguards.

20% chance: The {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}hexe{/#4} will make your {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}superstitious{/#8} brother become {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} afraid after the battle. He gets a bad mood too. ({#12}Witch Curse{/#12})
5% chance: Instead of fighting, the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}hexe{/#4} will offer two different vials for the the firstborn's life. ({#5}A Hexe Offers a Bargain for the Firstborn's Life{/#5})
units.zh: 5% 概率：{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}女巫{/#4}不愿交战，提出用两瓶不同的药剂换取长子的性命。（{#5}女巫以药剂换取长子性命{/#5}）

units.source: The settlement will no longer have the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}abducted children{/#4} situation if you fulfill this contract.
10% chance: You meet a man that wants to protect the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}lindwurms{/#4}. ({#5}Animal Activist{/#5})

10% chance: The {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}lindwurms{/#4} are attacking a caravan. If less than 5 caravans are destroyed you get an extra reward. You get 3 extra caravan hands for the fight. The reward is that an undead location is revealed that will contain a named item. ({#5}Merchant in Distress{/#5})
units.zh: 10% 概率：{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}林德蠕龙{/#4}正在袭击商队。若商队阵亡单位（杂工与驴合计）少于 5 个，可获得额外奖励。战斗中有 3 名额外的商队杂工帮忙；奖励是获知一处藏有名贵装备的亡灵据点位置。（{#5}遇险商人{/#5}）

units.source: If you kill the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}lindwurms{/#4}, the settlement will no longer have {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}ambushed trade routes{/#8}.
Kill the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}schrats{/#4} in the woods around the settlement.
20% chance: You will face {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}direwolves{/#4} in addition to the {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}schrats{/#8}.
5% chance: After the battle you gain 2x {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}quality wood{/#4}. ({#5}Chopping Trees{/#5})
10% chance: After the battle you notice a dead woodcutter and take his axe. (its a {#1}woodcutters axe{/#1}, {#2}handaxe{/#2}, {#3}fighting axe{/#3} or {#4}greataxe{/#4})
units.zh: 10% 概率：战后发现一名死去的伐木工，取走他的斧头，可能是{#1}伐木斧{/#1}、{#2}手斧{/#2}、{#3}战斧{/#3}或{#4}巨斧{/#4}。

units.source: The settlement will no longer have the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}disapearing villagers{/#4} situation if you fulfill this contract.

You can face {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}unholds{/#4} that exist in the hills and tundra, {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}bog unholds{/#8} that exist in swamps and forests or {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}frost unholds{/#12} that exist in the snowy wastes.
The settlement will no longer have the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}unhold attacks{/#4} situation if you fulfill this contract.
Hunt down {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}webknechts{/#4} in the woods around the settlement.

10% chance: After fighting the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}webknechts{/#4} you find the remains of a dead knight and salvage what you can from him. You gain a {#5}decayed coat of scales{/#5} or {#6}decayed reinforced mail hauberk{/#6}. ({#7}Deceased Knight{/#7})

10% chance: After killing all the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}webknechts{/#4} you discover a {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}retired soldier{/#8}. He offers to join you. He will always have the {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}fear of beasts{/#12} or {#13}{#14}{#15/}{/#14}{/#13} {#16}hate for beasts{/#16} trait. ({#17}Lone Survivor{/#17})
The contract can give {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}venison{/#4}, {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}mushrooms{/#8} or {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}roots and berries{/#12} as additional reward.
10% chance: You meet graverobbers. They offer a map that leads to a site rich in treasures if you let them go free. ({#1}Graverobbers Offer Map{/#1})
units.zh: 10% 概率：遇到盗墓贼。若放他们一马，他们愿意交出地图，指向一处宝物丰厚的地点。（{#1}盗墓贼献图{/#1}）

units.source: 50% chance: You get at least 1/2 of your pay despite letting them go free.
units.zh: 50% 概率：即使放走他们，仍可得到至少 1/2 的报酬。

units.source: ~25% chance: You get a follow-up contract to hunt down a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Necromancers{/#4}.
If you finish this contract the settlement will no longer have {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Terrified Villagers{/#4}.
Obtain a named relic at a location of the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}ancient dead{/#4}.
You get the relic right before the confrontation begins and could just retreat if you dont wish to fight.
units.zh: 交战开始前便会拿到圣物，因此若不想打，可以直接撤退。

units.source: 10% chance: You can dare to pick up an {#1}ancient sword{/#1}, {#2}bladed pike{/#2}, {#3}crypt cleaver{/#3}, {#4}khopesh{/#4}, {#5}rhomphaia{/#5} or {#6}warscythe{/#6}. ({#7}Ancient Weapon{/#7})
If you manage to bring the named relic back, the settlement will get the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}high spirits{/#4} settlement situation.
Secure the ruined location near the settlement, then return to the settlement and escort the workers to the location.
units.zh: 先清理聚落附近的废墟，再回聚落护送工人前往。

units.source: Follow the tracks near the settlement and return the item.
units.zh: 追踪聚落附近的足迹，追回失物。

units.source: 15% chance: You will face a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Necromancers{/#4} and {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Brigands{/#8}. ({#9}A Pale Man in Black{/#9})
15% chance: After obtaining the stolen property, you are offered a higher reward for the object by a shady man. Accepting the offer will result in the failure of the contract. ({#1}Good Deal{/#1})
units.zh: 15% 概率：追回失物后，一个可疑人物愿出更高的价钱购买。接受交易会导致委托失败。（{#1}好买卖{/#1}）

units.source: 5% chance: You will face {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}disguised bandits{/#4} that look like {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}direwolves{/#8}.
You are expected to hunt a specific kind of enemies in a region on the world map, collect up to 8-30 heads and return at any time to get paid.
units.zh: 在世界地图的指定区域猎杀某类敌人，收集人头。委托的人头上限为 8-30 个，可以随时回去领取报酬。

units.source: Destroy any greenskin {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} siege engines and greenskins around the settlement.
units.zh: 摧毁聚落周围的绿皮{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}攻城器械，并消灭绿皮部队。

units.source: Company of soldiers is dispatched at the start of the contract. They move to reinforce settlement defenses. You could take advantage of it as they engage any greenskin forces they meet on their way to the besieged settlement.
units.zh: 委托开始时，会有一支士兵队伍出发增援聚落。他们在前往被围聚落的路上会攻击遇到的绿皮部队，你可以借助他们的力量。

units.source: You usually destroy 2-3 raiding parties and 1-2 siege engine camps.
units.zh: 通常需要消灭 2-3 支劫掠队，并摧毁 1-2 处攻城器械营地。

units.source: The player can resupply in besieged settlement without a problem.
units.zh: 可以照常进入被围的聚落补充物资。

units.source: Destroy any greenskin parties and camps to lure out their warlord. Kill the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}orc warlord{/#4}.
It can take awhile, so do not be discouraged and keep killing greenskins.
units.zh: 可能需要一段时间，不必灰心，继续消灭绿皮即可。

units.source: 10% chance: You encounter an {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}orc berserker{/#4} camp and can choose to attack them.
If you dont attack, your {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Houndmaster{/#4} gets a bad mood.
Travel to the holy site and conquer it from the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}southern forces{/#4}.
20% chance: Allied army of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}noble forces{/#4} is already besieging the site and will support you in battle.
20% chance: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}southern forces{/#4} will sally forth to attack you.

20% chance: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Mercenary{/#4} company hired by the southerners offers to switch sides for 50% of your contract reward. If you pay, they'll help you in battle and if you refuse you'll have to fight them in addition to the {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}southerners{/#8}.

20% chance: After the battle you will have to fight another army of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}southerners{/#4}. You will have an option to make a stand in the holy site, attack them in the open or run away which will result in failing the contract.
units.zh: 20% 概率：战后又有一支{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}南方军队{/#4}来袭。可以选择据守圣地、出城迎战，或逃走；逃走会导致委托失败。

units.source: Travel to the holy site and defend it against the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}southern forces{/#4}.

The holy site will be attacked by an army of southerners. Before the attack you will have a choice between building palisades for defense, scouring the grounds for some items or recruit some poorly equipped zealots to help you in the fight.
units.zh: 南方军队即将进攻圣地。开战前，可以选择修筑防御栅栏、搜寻场地里的物品，或招募装备简陋的狂信徒助战。

units.source: 25% chance: Quatermaster of your employer offers few {#1}Wardogs{/#1}, {#2}Throwing Nets{/#2} or {#3}Throwing Spears{/#3} ({#4}Javelins{/#4} if no Warriors of the North DLC installed)
units.zh: 25% 概率：雇主的军需官提供几条{#1}战犬{/#1}、一些{#2}投网{/#2}或{#3}投矛{/#3}；未安装北境勇士 DLC 时，投矛改为{#4}标枪{/#4}。

units.source: 30% chance: You will have an option to sally forth and ambush the enemy forces. If you choose to do so, you will fight two weaker waves of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}southern forces{/#4} one after another.
units.zh: 30% 概率：可以选择主动出击，伏击敌军。若这样做，将接连对付两波较弱的{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}南方军队{/#4}。

units.source: 30% chance: Allied {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}noble forces{/#4} will offer support. You can either ask them to flank {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}gunners{/#8} or {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}infantry{/#12} to reduce their respective numbers or order noble forces to stay with you.
20% chance: The {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}goblins{/#4} can prepare an ambush and throw a higher number of them at you.

75% chance: If you are flagged as a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} betrayer, your noble house might send a {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}noble force{/#7} to kill you after destroying the goblin camp. You are no longer flagged after that.
units.zh: 75% 概率：若已被标记为{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}背叛者，雇主家族可能在地精营地被摧毁后，派出{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4}{#7}贵族军队{/#7}追杀你。此后背叛者标记会清除。

units.source: Completing this contract removes the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}marauding greenskins{/#4} settlement situation.
10% You start the fight surrounded by two different {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}orc{/#4} factions that are fighting each other. ({#5}Orcs vs Orcs{/#5})
5% chance: You find a prisoner that wants to join your company after defeating the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}orc{/#4} camp. ({#5}Orc Prisoner{/#5})

75% chance: If you are flagged as a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} betrayer, your noble house might send a {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}noble force{/#7} to kill you after destroying the {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} {#11}orc{/#11} camp. You are no longer flagged after that.
If the envoy is killed during a battle, the contract will fail.
units.zh: 使者若在战斗中死亡，委托就会失败。

units.source: Once the destination is reached, the envoy will leave the party for several hours, then join back.
units.zh: 抵达目的地后，使者会离队数小时，然后重新归队。

units.source: The envoy must be escorted back to the settlement where the contract was accepted.
units.zh: 必须将使者护送回最初接取委托的聚落。

units.source: 10% chance: After meeting a shady man your envoy may get attacked by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Mercenaries{/#4} and you can choose a side. Defending the envoy simply continues the contract, taking the deal will get you the bribe money instead and you get flagged as a {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} betrayer by that noble house. ({#8}Shady Deal{/#8})
units.zh: 10% 概率：与可疑人物接洽后，使者可能遭到{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}佣兵{/#4}袭击，你可以选择立场。保护使者会正常继续委托；接受交易则改为拿取贿金，并被该贵族家族标记为{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}背叛者。（{#8}可疑交易{/#8}）

units.source: 54% chance: You fight an {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}undead{/#4} army and get the relic afterwards.
Your {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}historian{/#4} points out that you are going in the wrong direction and reveals the correct location.
units.zh: 队伍中的{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}历史学者{/#4}指出你走错了方向，并揭示正确地点。

units.source: You arrived at the wrong location and the correct location gets revealed.
units.zh: 抵达的地点不对，随后会揭示正确地点。

units.source: 16% chance: You found a map that suggests the relic to be located in another undead location.
units.zh: 16% 概率：发现一张地图，表明圣物位于另一处亡灵据点。

units.source: 5% chance: A random brother steps on a trap and receives a {#1}temporary injury{/#1} when you reach the location.
units.zh: 5% 概率：抵达目标地点时，一名随机弟兄踩中陷阱，受到{#1}暂时伤势{/#1}。

units.source: 5% chance: You find that someone else took the relic before you arrived. Catch up to them and get the artifact back. ({#1}Nemesis{/#1})
units.zh: 5% 概率：发现有人抢先取走了圣物。追上他们，把圣物夺回来。（{#1}宿敌{/#1}）

units.source: Search the battlesite for clues and free any prisoners you find.
units.zh: 搜查战场遗址中的线索，并释放找到的俘虏。

units.source: 5% chance: You find a prisoner that wants to join your company after reaching the battlesite. ({#1}Orc Survivor{/#1})
units.zh: 5% 概率：抵达战场遗址后，发现一名愿意入团的俘虏。（{#1}兽人袭击的幸存者{/#1}）

units.source: 5% chance: While on the battlesite you find a powerful weapon. ({#1}greatsword{/#1}, {#2}greataxe{/#2}, {#3}billhook{/#3}, {#4}noble sword{/#4}, {#5}warbrand{/#5}, {#6}two-handed hammer{/#6}, {#7}man splitter{/#7}, {#8}head chopper{/#8}, {#9}named orc axe{/#9} or {#10}named orc cleaver{/#10})
5% chance: A random brother suffers a {#1}temporary injury{/#1} while searching the battlesite.
units.zh: 5% 概率：搜查战场遗址时，一名随机弟兄受到{#1}暂时伤势{/#1}。

units.source: 15% chance: You get attacked by scouts that came back to loot the battlesite. You will fight {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}goblins{/#4} and {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}orcs{/#8}.
30% chance: A camp is revealed and you will face {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}goblins{/#4} and {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}orcs{/#8} fighting together.
20% chance: The camp is empty and you free the prisoners without fighting.
units.zh: 20% 概率：营地空无一人，无须战斗即可释放俘虏。

units.source: 50% chance: You have to pursuit the greenskins to free the prisoners.
units.zh: 50% 概率：必须追赶绿皮，才能解救俘虏。

units.source: 20% chance: You get ambushed by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}goblins{/#4}. You get to free the prisoners after the battle.
You have to defeat 2-3 waves of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}southern forces{/#4} raiding the Settlement's {#5}Attached Locations{/#5}.
40% chance: You will fight wave of slavers which will contain large number of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Indebted{/#4}.
50% chance: After defeating all raiding parties, a group of thankful villagers will give you some {#1}Trade Goods{/#1} and/or {#2}Food{/#2} produced by the settlement.
units.zh: 50% 概率：击败所有劫掠队后，村民为表示感谢，会赠送当地出产的{#1}贸易货物{/#1}、{#2}食物{/#2}，或两者都有。

units.source: If all locations are burned you fail the contract.
units.zh: 若所有地点都被烧毁，委托失败。

units.source: If at least one but not all locations are burned, you poorly complete the contract. You gain 50% less crowns & {#1}Relation{/#1}. You get the normal amount of {#2}Renown{/#2}.
units.zh: 若至少一处地点被烧毁，但仍保住了部分地点，则以较差结果完成委托：克朗报酬和{#1}关系{/#1}提升均减少 50%，{#2}声望{/#2}奖励不变。

units.source: Travel to a settlement and defend it against the undead.
units.zh: 前往聚落，抵御亡灵进攻。

units.source: The settlement will be attacked by 3 waves of undead. You will receive help from militia men. The less militia men die, the more will join you against the next undead wave.
units.zh: 聚落会遭到 3 波亡灵进攻，民兵会协助防守。阵亡的民兵越少，下一波能继续帮忙的人就越多。

units.source: 40% chance: Undead are already at the walls and you have to get past them first.
units.zh: 40% 概率：亡灵已经逼近城墙，你必须先突破它们。

units.source: 30% chance: There will be an additional wave consisting of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}nachzehrers{/#4}.
You will face a group of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}goblins{/#4} or {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}orcs{/#8}. (whoever's camp is closer to the settlement)
5% chance: You will face an {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}orc warlord{/#4} or {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}goblin shaman{/#8} in addition to the group.
5% chance: You meet a merchant after the battle that will give you extra crowns if you return him to the settlement. ({#1}Scared Merchant{/#1})
units.zh: 5% 概率：战后遇到一名商人，将他护送回聚落可获得额外克朗。（{#1}受惊的商人{/#1}）

units.source: Patrol two settlements, then come back to where the contract was accepted.
units.zh: 巡逻两处聚落，然后返回接取委托的地方。

units.source: You are paid for up to 20-35 heads you bring back. The heads can be from any enemy. (resurrected enemies, war dogs, goblin wolves, spider eggs and lindwurm tails dont give heads on kill) You have 5 days time to collect them. The closest bandit, orc and goblin camps will spawn a roaming party while you are on this contract.
units.zh: 按带回的人头数领取报酬，计酬上限为 20-35 个。任何敌人的人头都可以，但复活的敌人、战犬、地精坐骑狼、蛛卵和林德蠕龙尾巴不计入。收集时限为 5 天。执行委托期间，最近的强盗、兽人和地精营地会各生成一支游荡部队。

units.source: 10% chance: You get a scouting report about a crucified man. ({#1}Crucified{/#1})
units.zh: 10% 概率：斥候报告发现了一个被钉在十字架上的人。（{#1}被钉十字架的人{/#1}）

units.source: 33% chance: The settlement you patrol gets the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}safe roads{/#4} settlement situation.
Travel to the lands of noble house x, raid and burn down places, destroy any caravans or patrols and return after 5 days.
units.zh: 前往指定贵族家族 x 的领地，劫掠并烧毁地点，摧毁商队或巡逻队，5 天后返回。

units.source: 15+ score points: You completed the contract, you gain 2x the reputation.
units.zh: 得分达到 15 或以上：委托完成，获得 2 倍声誉。

units.source: 15% chance: A messenger of the enemy noble house offers you a named weapon if you change sides. ({#1}Changing Sides{/#1})
units.zh: 15% 概率：敌对贵族家族的信使以一件名贵武器为报酬，劝你倒戈。（{#1}改换阵营{/#1}）

units.source: You get less reputation if someone escaped and for each person that escaped there is a 10% chance that you fail the contract and get no payment at all.
units.zh: 若有人逃走，声誉奖励会减少；每逃走一人，还有 10% 的概率导致委托失败，一分钱也拿不到。

units.source: You can choose to sweep from one side or to encircle them at the start of the encounter.
units.zh: 遭遇开始时，可以选择从一侧扫荡，或将对方包围。

units.source: 25% chance: You will face {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}militia forces{/#4} in addition to the {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}peasants{/#8}.

75% chance: If you are flagged as a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} betrayer, your noble house might send a {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}noble force{/#7} to kill you when you arrive at the attached location. You are no longer flagged after that.
units.zh: 75% 概率：若已被标记为{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}背叛者，抵达附属地点时，雇主家族可能派出{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4}{#7}贵族军队{/#7}追杀你。此后背叛者标记会清除。

units.source: The settlement you attacked will get the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}raided{/#4} settlement situation for 3 days.
10% chance: You have to chase and kill 2 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Necromancers{/#4} that want to get away.
15% chance: You meet {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Brigands{/#4} as you approach the objective. ({#5}Cooperational Brigands{/#5})
Travel to settlement A and help in the siege.
units.zh: 前往聚落 A，协助围城。

units.source: 50% chance: You assault the castle and will face {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}noble forces{/#4}.
After the assault on the caste you have to fight another {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}noble force{/#4}.

30% chance: After the castle was set on fire you will face {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}noble forces{/#4} and a {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}knight{/#8}. You get support from your own noble troops aswell.
20% chance: You get to decide between assault on the castle and raining down fire on the castle.
units.zh: 20% 概率：可以选择强攻城堡，或以火攻轰击城堡。

units.source: 50% chance: You will maintain the siege and intercept anyone trying to break through.
units.zh: 50% 概率：继续围城，拦截所有试图突围或穿过包围圈的人。

units.source: 25% chance: You fight some {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}noble forces{/#4} and discover a secret passage into the objective.
units.zh: 25% 概率：与一支{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}贵族军队{/#4}交战，随后发现一条通往目标内部的密道。

units.source: You get the order to sneak in and assassinate the enemies commander. You will start the fight surrounded by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}noble forces{/#4} and a {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}knight{/#8}.
75% chance: Some {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}noble forces{/#4} start attacking you to relief the settlement.

60% chance: The defenders send their last attack force at you. You will face {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}noble forces{/#4} and a {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}knight{/#8}. You get support from your own noble troops aswell.
10% chance: Your men captured some of the defenders. You get to decide their fate. ({#1}Siege Prisoners{/#1})
units.zh: 10% 概率：弟兄们俘获了部分守军，由你决定如何处置。（{#1}围城俘虏{/#1}）

units.source: During the contract the settlement will have the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}besieged{/#4} settlement situation.
After this contract the settlement will gain the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}conquered{/#4} settlement situation for 3 days.

15% chance: The barbarian king asks you stop a bigger threat, an army of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Ancient Dead{/#4}. If you agree and beat them you get a {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}heavy horned plate helmet{/#8} and complete the contract.
A {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} barbarian army together with a {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} will be spawned at the closest possible barbarian location.
Travel to the holy site and conquer it from the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}northern forces{/#4}.
20% chance: Allied army of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}southern forces{/#4} is already besieging the site and will support you in battle.
20% chance: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}northern forces{/#4} will sally forth to attack you.

20% chance: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Mercenary{/#4} company hired by the nobles offers to switch sides for 50% of your contract reward. If you pay, they'll help you in battle and if you refuse you'll have to fight them in addition to the {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}noble forces{/#8}.

20% chance: After the battle you will have to fight another army of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}northerners{/#4}. You will have an option to make a stand in the holy site, attack them in the open or run away which will result in failing the contract.
units.zh: 20% 概率：战后又有一支{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}北方军队{/#4}来袭。可以选择据守圣地、出城迎战，或逃走；逃走会导致委托失败。

units.source: Travel to the holy site and defend it against the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}northern forces{/#4}.

The holy site will be attacked by an army of northerners. Before the attack you will have a choice between building palisades for defense, scouring the grounds for some items or recruit some poorly equipped zealots to help you in the fight.
units.zh: 北方军队即将进攻圣地。开战前，可以选择修筑防御栅栏、搜寻场地里的物品，或招募装备简陋的狂信徒助战。

units.source: 25% chance: Alchemist of your employer offers two {#1}Flash Pots{/#1}, {#2}Fire Pots{/#2} or {#3}Smoke Pots{/#3}.
units.zh: 25% 概率：雇主的炼金术士提供两个{#1}闪光罐{/#1}、{#2}燃烧罐{/#2}或{#3}烟雾罐{/#3}。

units.source: 30% chance: You will have an option to sally forth and ambush the enemy forces. If you choose to do so, you will fight two weaker waves of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}northern forces{/#4} one after another.
units.zh: 30% 概率：可以选择主动出击，伏击敌军。若这样做，将接连对付两波较弱的{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}北方军队{/#4}。

units.source: 30% chance: Allied {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}southern forces{/#4} will offer support. You can either ask them to flank {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}arbalesters{/#8} or {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}infantry{/#12} to reduce their respective numbers or order them to stay with you.
10% chance: The camp is attacked by {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Ifrits{/#4} hostile to both your company and the nomads

15% chance: You find nomads digging in the earth. You can attack now and face more enemies but gain some {#1}Treasures{/#1} afterwards or wait until they leave and the camp is less defended. ({#2}Nomad Treasure{/#2})
units.zh: 15% 概率：发现游牧民正在挖掘。可以立即进攻，面对更多敌人，战后获得一些{#1}财宝{/#1}；也可以等挖掘者离开，再进攻守备较弱的营地。（{#2}游牧民的宝藏{/#2}）

units.source: 10% chance: You will also face few {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Assassins{/#4} in addition to the nomads.
10% chance: You face {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Necromancers{/#4} and nomads turned into {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Zombies{/#8}.
If you destroy their camp, there is a 50% chance that settlement will no longer have {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}ambushed trade routes{/#4}.
Travel to the abandoned fortress and defend it against {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}northern forces{/#4}.
You have to defend against 2-3 waves of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}northern forces{/#4}. If you stray too far from the fortress, you will fail the contract.
20% chance: In the third wave you will get {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} reinforcements from your employer.
30% chance: You will get an ultimatum after the second wave. If you accept it, you will fail the contract and switch the sides in the war.
units.zh: 30% 概率：第二波进攻后收到最后通牒。接受后，委托失败，你也会在战争中改投另一方。

units.source: Hunt down {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Ifrits{/#4} in the sands around the settlement.
If you kill the ifrits, the settlement will no longer have {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Mirage Sightings{/#4}.
Hunt down {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Serpents{/#4} in the wetlands near the settlement.
If you kill the serpents, the settlement will no longer have {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Moving Sands{/#4}.
Beat down the uprising of the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Indebted{/#4} in the location near the settlement.
20% chance: You have to chase the indebted that turned into banditry (nomads).
units.zh: 20% 概率：必须追赶已经落草为寇、转为游牧匪徒的负债者。

units.source: 20% chance: Leader of the indebted offers a bargain for their freedom. Accepting the offer will result in the failure of the contract but an undead location will be revealed that will contain a named item. ({#1}Spartacus{/#1})
units.zh: 20% 概率：负债者首领提出交易，以换取众人的自由。接受会导致委托失败，但会揭示一处藏有名贵装备的亡灵据点。（{#1}斯巴达克斯{/#1}）

units.source: 20% chance: You have to chase the indebted who fled the location.
units.zh: 20% 概率：必须追赶逃离据点的负债者。

units.source: If you put down the revolt, the settlement will no longer have {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Slave Revolt{/#4}.
DISCLAIMER{#1/} This guide is not updated for the 'Beasts & Exploration' DLC. So most of the builds detailed here are not optimal anymore unless one is still playing version 1.1.x.
units.zh: 旧版攻略说明{#1/}本文尚未按“野兽与探索”DLC 更新。除非仍在游玩 1.1.x 版本，否则下述多数配装已不是最优选择。

units.source: This is the result of an extensive amount of playing and testing various character builds and combinations. This guide is intended for late to end game. Mid and early game especially, because of economic and recruitment constraints, require different builds with a stress on {#1}Perks{/#1} that improve {#2}Attributes{/#2} for immediate return on investment. The following builds are meant for the long run and will show better results once the characters reach Veteran {#3}Level{/#3}.
units.zh: 本文汇集了作者大量游玩、测试不同角色配装及组合后的经验，主要面向后期和终局。中期，尤其是前期，受经济和招募条件限制，需要采用不同的培养方式，优先选择能直接提高{#2}属性{/#2}、立刻见效的{#1}特长{/#1}。下述方案着眼于长期，角色进入老兵{#3}等级{/#3}后才会更显优势。

units.source: Please note that while these builds were used in Expert difficulty, they should work for every other difficulty settings. But they were designed for maximum offense and may despite everything die to very bad luck. For that reason, Ironman players may want to switch some suggested {#1}Perks{/#1} for fail safes like Rotation or Footwork and Colossus. While the former ones are quite unreliable due to huge {#2}Fatigue{/#2} costs, they can save lives.
units.zh: 这些配装在专家难度下使用，也适用于其他难度。不过，它们追求最高输出，运气极差时仍可能阵亡。因此，铁人模式玩家可以把部分推荐{#1}特长{/#1}换成换位、灵活步法或巨人体魄等保命选项。前两者的{#2}疲劳{/#2}消耗很高，未必总能用上，但关键时刻可以救命。

units.source: These builds should cover all your needs. If I skipped some {#1}Perks{/#1} of interest, I usually explain why. However, some {#2}Weapons{/#2} are not mentioned at all because I deemed them not as effective as others. This is notably the case for {#3}Throwing Weapons{/#3} and {#4}Crossbows{/#4} that become less and less good than {#5}Bows{/#5} the longer the campaign goes (I will not demonstrate why here). Most one-handed {#6}Melee Weapons{/#6} while excellent in early to mid game also lose much value after a couple years.
units.zh: 这些方案应能覆盖各种需求。若没有选择某些值得考虑的{#1}特长{/#1}，我通常会解释原因。有些{#2}武器{/#2}则完全未提，因为我认为它们不如其他选择。尤其是{#3}投掷武器{/#3}和{#4}弩类{/#4}，在本文所依据的旧版本中，战役越长，就越逊色于{#5}弓类{/#5}，这里不再展开论证。多数单手{#6}近战武器{/#6}在前中期虽很出色，战役持续数年后也会明显贬值。

units.source: Knights are the epitome of valor and martial skill. They follow a long, hard training in all kinds of weapons and wear heavy {#1}Armor{/#1} in battle. They often come from the nobility and from families that are wealthy enough to buy their equipment. Knights not only win favor from their lord by showing their strength in war but also by jousting in tournaments or by displaying chivalrous qualities at court.
units.zh: 骑士象征着勇气与武艺。他们长期刻苦训练各种武器，身披重型{#1}护甲{/#1}作战，常出身贵族或有能力购置装备的富裕家庭。骑士不仅在战争中凭实力赢得领主青睐，也会在比武大会上较量，或在宫廷中展现骑士风范。

units.source: Champions are trained in a variety of combat tactics that make them equally dangerous against all types of enemies. Unlike {#1}Crusaders{/#1} who focus on foot combatants, Champions are also able to take on and dodge or shield volleys of arrows while swinging their {#2}Swords{/#2}.
units.zh: 勇士受过多种战术训练，能有效对付各类敌人。与侧重近战的{#1}十字军{/#1}不同，勇士还擅长一边挥舞{#2}剑类{/#2}，一边承受、闪避或格挡成片射来的箭矢。

units.source: Sellswords start with higher average {#1}Ranged Defense{/#1}. So they will usually make better Champions than other {#2}Backgrounds{/#2}.
units.zh: 佣兵的初始{#1}远程防御{/#1}平均更高，因此通常比其他{#2}背景{/#2}更适合培养成勇士。

units.source: {#1}Fatigue{/#1} is preferred to {#2}Ranged Defense{/#2} before Veteran {#3}Level{/#3} since the level-up range is wider ([2-4] vs. [1-3]). The bonus provided by the {#4}Kite Shield{/#4} should be enough.
units.zh: 进入老兵{#3}等级{/#3}前，优先提升{#1}疲劳上限{/#1}，而非{#2}远程防御{/#2}，因为升级增幅更大，分别为 [2-4] 与 [1-3]。{#4}鸢形盾{/#4}提供的防御加成应当够用。

units.source: Besides the standard {#1}Knight{/#1} core level 5 to 7 {#2}Perks{/#2}, this build uses the Quick Hands and Bags and Belts combination. More weapons for no {#3}Fatigue{/#3}!
units.zh: 除{#1}骑士{/#1}通用的 5 至 7 级核心{#2}特长{/#2}外，这套配装还选用快手与行囊与腰带的组合，可以多带武器而不增加{#3}疲劳{/#3}负担。

units.source: {#1}Sword{/#1} and {#2}Shield{/#2} is the default starting set-up. It's useful for first engagement. The {#3}Sword{/#3} +10% hit chance can also come useful against elusive foes like {#4}Geists{/#4}.
units.zh: 默认以{#1}剑{/#1}和{#2}盾牌{/#2}开场，适合首次接敌。{#3}剑{/#3}的 +10% 命中率也有助于对付{#4}怨魂{/#4}等难以命中的敌人。

units.source: Double Grip {#1}Sword{/#1} can be used in conjunction with Berserk and Recover to slay a near death enemy while regaining some {#2}Fatigue{/#2}.
units.zh: 双手握持{#1}剑{/#1}，配合狂战和恢复体力，可以先击杀濒死敌人，再恢复一部分{#2}疲劳{/#2}。

units.source: The {#1}Shield{/#1} can be taken out if Reach Advantage isn't good enough or to increase {#2}Ranged Defense{/#2}.
units.zh: 若长兵优势提供的防护不足，或需要提高{#2}远程防御{/#2}，可以取出{#1}盾牌{/#1}。

units.source: The {#1}Greatsword{/#1} is the primary, {#2}Fatigue{/#2} effective weapon. Use it rather than the {#3}Two-Handed Hammer{/#3} for multiple targets swings and against unarmored opponents.
units.zh: {#1}巨剑{/#1}是主武器，{#2}疲劳{/#2}利用率较高。进行多目标挥击或对付无甲敌人时，优先使用它，而非{#3}双手战锤{/#3}。

units.source: The {#1}Two-Handed Hammer{/#1} should be used for single target strikes against armored opponents.
units.zh: 对付有甲敌人时，用{#1}双手战锤{/#1}进行单体攻击。

units.source: {#1}Billhook{/#1} rounds up the weapons choice, giving the build needed additional range for very decent {#2}Damage{/#2}.
units.zh: 再带一把{#1}钩镰{/#1}补足武器组合，既能提供所需的额外攻击距离，也有相当不错的{#2}伤害{/#2}。

units.source: Champions are primarily meant to fight battles against ranged or mixed opponents like {#1}Brigands{/#1} and {#2}Goblins{/#2}. But they can also fight other enemies alongside {#3}Crusaders{/#3}.
units.zh: 勇士主要用于对付远程或混合阵容，例如{#1}强盗{/#1}和{#2}地精{/#2}；也可以与{#3}十字军{/#3}并肩迎战其他敌人。

units.source: Since they sacrifice some {#1}Fatigue{/#1} for additional {#2}Ranged Defense{/#2}, even if they have Brawny, you should consider giving them heavy but low {#3}Fatigue{/#3} penalty {#4}Armor{/#4}. Likewise, use your {#5}Greatsword{/#5} for swings and splits and stick to single target attacks with your {#6}Two-Handed Hammer{/#6}.
units.zh: 勇士牺牲了一部分{#1}疲劳上限{/#1}来换取{#2}远程防御{/#2}，因此即使有壮硕，也应考虑选择较重但{#3}疲劳{/#3}惩罚较低的{#4}护甲{/#4}。同理，用{#5}巨剑{/#5}进行挥击和劈开，{#6}双手战锤{/#6}则以单体攻击为主。

units.source: Crusaders embark on holy missions to rid the lands of the Undead and Orc scourge. While proficient with {#1}Swords{/#1} and {#2}Greatswords{/#2} like {#3}Champions{/#3}, they also learn to master {#4}Two-Handed Hammers{/#4} which they can use without exertion for devastating {#5}Damage{/#5} against heavily armored opponents.
units.zh: 十字军踏上圣战之路，清除大地上的亡灵和兽人。他们像{#3}勇士{/#3}一样精通{#1}剑类{/#1}与{#2}巨剑{/#2}，还会学习{#4}双手战锤{/#4}，以较低消耗对重甲敌人造成毁灭性的{#5}伤害{/#5}。

units.source: Hedge Knights and Adventurous Nobles will make the best Crusaders given their average base scores in core {#1}Attributes{/#1}. Sellswords are also great candidates but may suffer from a lower {#2}Fatigue{/#2} pool.
units.zh: 流浪骑士和冒险贵族的核心{#1}属性{/#1}初始均值较好，最适合培养成十字军。佣兵也是优秀人选，但{#2}疲劳上限{/#2}可能偏低。

units.source: Crusaders do not invest in {#1}Ranged Defense{/#1} so they can focus on increasing {#2}Fatigue{/#2} on level-up. If you get bad rolls {#3}Resolve{/#3} can be chosen instead.
units.zh: 十字军不投资{#1}远程防御{/#1}，升级时可以集中提高{#2}疲劳上限{/#2}。若本次增幅较差，也可改选{#3}意志{/#3}。

units.source: The {#1}Shield{/#1} can be taken out to increase the Crusader Defense after a strike or if Reach Advantage isn't good enough.
units.zh: 攻击后，或长兵优势的防护不足时，可以取出{#1}盾牌{/#1}，提高十字军的防御。

units.source: Crusaders have Mastery in {#1}Greatswords{/#1} as well as in {#2}Two-Handed Hammers{/#2}. So they can use whichever is required for identical {#3}Fatigue{/#3} costs. While the {#4}Greatsword{/#4} works best against unarmored opponents, the {#5}Two-Handed Hammer{/#5} should be used against armored opponents like {#6}Orc Warriors{/#6} and {#7}Honor Guards{/#7}.
units.zh: 十字军同时精通{#1}巨剑{/#1}和{#2}双手战锤{/#2}，可按需要切换，{#3}疲劳{/#3}消耗相同。{#4}巨剑{/#4}最适合无甲敌人，{#5}双手战锤{/#5}则用来对付{#6}兽人战士{/#6}和{#7}古代荣誉卫士{/#7}等有甲目标。

units.source: Unlike {#1}Champions{/#1}, Crusaders will not fare well against ranged enemies. If you still have to line them up in a battle that involves some, give them cover and a {#2}Kite Shield{/#2}.
units.zh: 与{#1}勇士{/#1}不同，十字军不擅长应对远程敌人。若仍须上场，应安排掩护，并给他们配上{#2}鸢形盾{/#2}。

units.source: {#1}Hammer{/#1} Mastery will spare you more {#2}Fatigue{/#2} than Brawny in the long run, which is why it is preferred on this build.
units.zh: 长期作战时，{#1}战锤{/#1}精通节省的{#2}疲劳{/#2}比壮硕更多，因此这套方案优先选择前者。

units.source: {#1}Hammer{/#1} and {#2}Sword{/#2} combination is better than {#3}Axe{/#3} alone because it offers all possible types of attack and optimal {#4}Damage{/#4} against both armored and unarmored opponents.
units.zh: {#1}战锤{/#1}与{#2}剑{/#2}的组合优于单用{#3}斧{/#3}，因为它覆盖各种攻击方式，对有甲和无甲敌人都能打出理想的{#4}伤害{/#4}。

units.source: Berserkers channel their anger into a frenzied like state during which they will strike twice as hard as any {#1}Knight{/#1}. When they start swinging their {#2}Greataxe{/#2}, it is well advised not to approach them for in the rush of battle, they will hit anyone, friend or foe.
units.zh: 狂战士将怒火化为狂暴之力，攻击威势远胜{#1}骑士{/#1}。当他们抡起{#2}巨斧{/#2}时，最好别靠近；杀红眼的他们会把身旁所有人一并卷入，不分敌我。

units.source: The preferred {#1}Background{/#1} is Swordmaster because it gets bonuses in three important {#2}Attributes{/#2} for that build. {#3}Fatigue{/#3} could be a problem early on though, especially if the Swordmaster gets Old. That makes this character a prime candidate for the Emperor's {#4}Armor{/#4} set. Adventurous Nobles come second thanks to their high natural {#5}Resolve{/#5}.
units.zh: 首选{#1}背景{/#1}是剑术大师，因为它在这套方案的三项关键{#2}属性{/#2}上都有加成。不过前期{#3}疲劳上限{/#3}可能不足，尤其在获得年迈特性后，因此非常适合穿戴皇帝{#4}护甲{/#4}套装。冒险贵族凭借较高的基础{#5}意志{/#5}，是次选。

units.source: Berserkers should fight melee only battles. Since they carry no {#1}Shields{/#1}, Archers would likely target and hit them a lot.
units.zh: 狂战士应参加只有近战敌人的战斗。他们不带{#1}盾牌{/#1}，很容易成为弓手集火的目标。

units.source: This character should be positioned on one of the far sides. As soon as you feel comfortable with your {#1}Melee Defense{/#1} score, you can pull four tiles away to activate Lone Wolf and set up for Round Swings. It's also possible to do so while having brothers adjacent since the -10% hit chance penalty after {#2}Axe{/#2} Mastery should prevent any friendly hits.
units.zh: 将这类角色安排在阵线最侧翼。待{#1}近战防御{/#1}足够可靠后，就可以离开友军四格，触发孤狼，并准备施展回旋斩。原文作者还建议在友军相邻时这样做，理由是{#2}斧{/#2}精通后的 -10% 命中率惩罚应能避免误伤；这是旧版攻略的判断，不能视为绝不会误伤的保证。

units.source: Be watchful of {#1}Orc Warriors{/#1} reaching you when you're isolated. It's easy to lose {#2}Morale{/#2} if you're getting surrounded and knocked back, even with Old and Fortified Mind. So if you can, keep a {#3}Sergeant{/#3} not too far away.
units.zh: 单独作战时，要提防{#1}兽人战士{/#1}靠近。即使有年迈和坚定心智，遭到包围、击退时仍很容易损失{#2}士气{/#2}。条件允许的话，让{#3}军士{/#3}待在不太远的地方。

units.source: Before reaching Veteran {#1}Level{/#1}, as with other builds, stick to one-handed {#2}Weapons{/#2} and {#3}Shields{/#3}. Or better even, stay behind and use a {#4}Pike{/#4} or a {#5}Longaxe{/#5}.
units.zh: 进入老兵{#1}等级{/#1}前，与其他方案一样，先用单手{#2}武器{/#2}搭配{#3}盾牌{/#3}。更稳妥的做法是待在后排，使用{#4}长枪{/#4}或{#5}长柄斧{/#5}。

units.source: Archers are an essential component of successful armies. They open a battle by firing volleys of arrows with their Longbows, effectively stopping and routing charging adversaries. They benefit most from high ground which gives them added sight and power. However they must not be left unprotected for highly mobile melee units will slay them without difficulty if given the chance.
units.zh: 弓手是强大军队不可或缺的一部分。他们以长弓齐射揭开战斗，阻挡并击溃冲锋的敌人。高地能增加视野和攻击优势，对弓手尤其有利。不过，不能让他们失去保护；一旦被机动灵活的近战敌人抓住机会，就可能迅速丧命。

units.source: Noble Houses train personal guards to watch over them when traveling or taking part in battles. They are not only surrounded by {#1}Knights{/#1} but also by Master {#2}Archers{/#2} who can take care of distant incoming threats and provide cover in emergencies. These Bowmen are so strong that they can carry and fire huge, heavy {#3}Bows{/#3} whose shots will pierce the heaviest {#4}Armors{/#4}.
units.zh: 贵族家族训练亲卫，在出行和参战时护卫左右。他们身边不仅有{#1}骑士{/#1}，也有精锐{#2}弓手{/#2}，负责清除远方威胁并在危急时提供掩护。这些弓手力大过人，能携带和拉开巨大沉重的{#3}弓类{/#3}，射穿最厚重的{#4}护甲{/#4}。

units.source: Hunters, with the single highest average {#1}Ranged Skill{/#1}, make undoubtedly the best {#2}Archers{/#2} of all {#3}Backgrounds{/#3}. Since Hunters can be difficult to find, you can also try your luck with Witchhunters. Given good {#4}Talents{/#4}, they can outperform average Hunters.
units.zh: 猎人的{#1}远程命中{/#1}初始均值最高，无疑是各{#3}背景{/#3}中最适合培养成{#2}弓手{/#2}的选择。若难以找到猎人，也可以尝试猎巫人；拥有优秀{#4}天赋{/#4}时，他们可能胜过普通猎人。

units.source: This build can accommodate any kind of {#1}Armor{/#1}. Medium to heavy {#2}Armor{/#2} is recommended. Heavy {#3}Armor{/#3}, while decreasing your maximum {#4}Fatigue{/#4} will provide extreme durability combined with high {#5}Ranged Defense{/#5} and Anticipation. That's why Battle Forged isn't really necessary. Most hits will be dodged so {#6}Armor{/#6} is only there to mitigate that one 5% hit chance shot you took from a {#7}Crossbow{/#7} bolt.
units.zh: 这套方案能使用各类{#1}护甲{/#1}，推荐中型至重型{#2}护甲{/#2}。重型{#3}护甲{/#3}虽会降低{#4}疲劳上限{/#4}，但配合较高的{#5}远程防御{/#5}与预判，生存能力很强，因此不一定需要久经战阵。多数攻击都能躲开，{#6}护甲{/#6}主要用于减轻偶尔那发以 5% 命中率打中的{#7}弩{/#7}矢。

units.source: Bullseye is extremely useful for effective targeting. Interesting targets include Marksmen and other Archers, {#1}Necromancers{/#1}, {#2}Shamans{/#2} and {#3}Overseers{/#3}, Billmen and other units with low {#4}Ranged Defense{/#4} in cover.
units.zh: 鹰眼非常有助于点杀关键目标，例如射手、其他弓手、{#1}亡灵法师{/#1}、{#2}地精萨满{/#2}、{#3}地精督军{/#3}、钩镰枪兵，以及躲在掩体后但{#4}远程防御{/#4}较低的单位。

units.source: Archers with their high {#1}Fatigue{/#1} are prime candidates for Adrenaline. With the usual Berserk and Recover trick you can still kill while getting the spent {#2}Fatigue{/#2} back. Adrenaline guarantees initiative in the next turn which can net you early kills or give you an opportunity to get out of bad situations against fast units like {#3}Wolfriders{/#3} or {#4}Orc Berserkers{/#4}.
units.zh: 弓手的{#1}疲劳上限{/#1}较高，很适合肾上腺素。配合常用的狂战与恢复体力组合，可以在击杀敌人的同时恢复已积累的{#2}疲劳{/#2}。肾上腺素确保下一回合先手，既可抢先击杀，也有助于摆脱{#3}地精狼骑兵{/#3}或{#4}兽人狂战士{/#4}等快速敌人的威胁。

units.source: Quick Hands is not necessary. Most of the time, two Quivers are enough which only costs 5 Action Points. And there's a high chance you'll come up with spare Action Points.
units.zh: 快手并非必选。多数时候带两个箭袋就够用，切换只需 5 点行动点，而且通常会有富余的行动点可用。

units.source: Crippling Strike and Executioner are not as good as they look. Since the majority of enemies die in one or two hit they're usually worthless.
units.zh: 致残打击和刽子手没有看上去那么好。多数敌人一两箭就会死，这两项特长通常派不上用场。

units.source: Your {#1}Ranged Defense{/#1} combined with Anticipation are enough that you can safely get closer to the enemy lines. It will not only increase your hit chance but also mitigate any penalty you may suffer to Vision for wearing heavy {#2}Headgear{/#2}. A {#3}Sallet{/#3} is the best you could get. It has high Durability and only -1 penalty to Vision.
units.zh: {#1}远程防御{/#1}配合预判，足以让你安全地靠近敌阵。这既能提高命中率，也能缓解重型{#2}头部装备{/#2}造成的视野惩罚。{#3}萨莱特盔{/#3}是理想选择，耐久高，视野惩罚仅为 -1。

units.source: It's a good idea to position your {#1}Archers{/#1} in the front. They get additional hit chance and provide excellent cover from the opponents missiles. It's very important to do so against {#2}Goblins{/#2} because it's likely your {#3}Archers{/#3} will get entangled by vines before reducing the distance to {#4}Shamans{/#4} and {#5}Overseers{/#5}.
units.zh: 可以把{#1}弓手{/#1}放在前排，以提高命中率，并为后方挡住敌军飞射物。对付{#2}地精{/#2}时尤其如此，因为{#3}弓手{/#3}很可能还没接近{#4}萨满{/#4}和{#5}督军{/#5}，就被藤蔓缠住。

units.source: You will find them in remote locations or small villages, scouring forests for game and setting traps to catch smaller animals. Hunters are exceptionally skillful with {#1}Bows{/#1} but unlike {#2}Bowmen{/#2} they carry lighter equipment for easier movement. While they hunt {#3}Beasts{/#3} better than {#4}men{/#4} they can also pull their weight as mercenaries should they ever wish to pursue that dangerous 'profession'.
units.zh: 猎人常见于偏远地点或小村落，在森林里追猎野兽、布设陷阱捕捉小动物。他们擅长使用{#1}弓类{/#1}，但与{#2}战弓手{/#2}不同，通常装备较轻，方便移动。虽然猎杀{#3}野兽{/#3}比猎杀{#4}人类{/#4}更拿手，只要愿意投身这门危险行当，他们也能成为称职的佣兵。

units.source: Hunters are {#1}Archers{/#1} with the Strong (mandatory) {#2}Trait{/#2} built towards Nimble. Unlike {#3}Bowmen{/#3}, once Nimble is active, they will wear light {#4}Armor{/#4} to increase the chance for grazing hits. Stick to medium or heavy {#5}Armor{/#5} until then.
units.zh: 猎手是围绕轻灵培养的{#1}弓手{/#1}，必须具备强壮{#2}特性{/#2}。与{#3}战弓手{/#3}不同，学会轻灵后应改穿轻型{#4}护甲{/#4}，提高旧版轻灵触发擦伤的概率；在此之前仍应穿中型或重型{#5}护甲{/#5}。

units.source: {#1}Hitpoints{/#1} are extremely interesting for Nimble characters as they more or less get twice as much for every point (supposing Nimble activates every time). That's why Colossus was picked as a last {#2}Perk{/#2}. {#3}Hitpoints{/#3} will act like {#4}Armor{/#4} as a buffer to avoid {#5}Injuries{/#5} and resist that one unlucky shot.
units.zh: 对轻灵角色而言，{#1}生命值{/#1}很有价值；假设每次都触发轻灵，每点生命值大致能发挥双倍作用，因此最后一项{#2}特长{/#2}选择巨人体魄。{#3}生命值{/#3}会像{#4}护甲{/#4}一样形成缓冲，避免{#5}伤势{/#5}，并扛住偶尔命中的那一箭。

units.source: Since the Hunter build is a slight variation from the {#1}Bowman{/#1}, the same advice applies. However, it's recommended to position him on the sides rather than in the center where more fire is potentially drawn.
units.zh: 猎手是{#1}战弓手{/#1}的小幅变体，因此前述建议同样适用。不过，建议把他放在侧翼，避开可能承受更多火力的阵线中央。

units.source: Great commanders are able to gather all kinds of men and give them the courage to fight even against impossible odds. After a time spent studying in war academies, they join the ranks of the military to lead soldiers on the field. They're able fighters but because they're essential to the outcome of wars they tend to stay behind the lines.
units.zh: 优秀的指挥官能将形形色色的人聚在一起，让他们即使面对看似毫无胜算的敌人，也有勇气战斗。他们在战争学院研习后投身军旅，指挥士兵作战。指挥官本身也善战，但因其关系到战争胜负，通常留在阵线后方。

units.source: These commanders have risen up to the rank of Marshal, an esteemed position among the military hierarchy. Marshals are often lords with fiefdoms that possess military and some kind of legal rule over their lands. When seen on the battlefield among their men, troops gain confidence.
units.zh: 这些指挥官已晋升为元帅，在军中地位尊崇。元帅往往也是拥有封地的领主，在领地内掌握军事及一定司法权。他们出现在士兵身边时，部队便会信心倍增。

units.source: Quick Hands and Bags and Belts make come as a surprise but they're necessary if you want your {#1}Standard{/#1} Bearer to do more than rally and deal {#2}Pike{/#2} {#3}Damage{/#3}. Quick Hands is obviously more important as it allows free Action Points switches between the {#4}Battle Standard{/#4} which can then provide {#5}Resolve{/#5} bonus and a {#6}Billhook{/#6} for increased {#7}Damage{/#7}. Bags and Belts is picked first because it cancels the {#8}Fatigue{/#8} penalty of -7 induced by carrying the {#9}Battle Standard{/#9} in your bag. And as an added perk you get more slots to play with.
units.zh: 快手与行囊与腰带的组合或许出人意料，但若想让{#1}旗手{/#1}除了鼓舞士气和打出{#2}长枪{/#2}{#3}伤害{/#3}之外还能做更多事，这两项就很有用。快手更关键，可以不花行动点切换{#4}战旗{/#4}与{#6}钩镰{/#6}，分别提供{#5}意志{/#5}加成或更高{#7}伤害{/#7}。先选行囊与腰带，则是为了抵消把{#9}战旗{/#9}放在背包中带来的 -7 {#8}疲劳上限{/#8}惩罚，额外背包格也是好处。

units.source: What {#1}Attributes{/#1} to raise for this build is a bit tricky. {#2}Melee Defense{/#2} is important if you intend to engage more in melee. But if you absolutely want to avoid it, you can skip it for more {#3}Fatigue{/#3} and possibly {#4}Resolve{/#4}.
units.zh: 这套方案的{#1}属性{/#1}分配需要权衡。若打算经常接敌，{#2}近战防御{/#2}很重要；若坚决避免近战，则可放弃它，多加{#3}疲劳上限{/#3}，也可以提高{#4}意志{/#4}。

units.source: Like the {#1}Captain{/#1}, the Marshal should not fight in battles involving ranged units. Such units and the ones they accompany have a low threatening level anyway and are not very likely to break your troops {#2}Morale{/#2}. That's the reason why {#3}Sergeants{/#3} do not need to invest in {#4}Ranged Defense{/#4}.
units.zh: 与{#1}队长{/#1}一样，元帅不宜参加有远程敌人的战斗。原文认为，这类敌人及其同伴的威胁较低，通常不足以击溃战团{#2}士气{/#2}，因此{#3}军士{/#3}无须投资{#4}远程防御{/#4}。

units.source: Small towns usually keep a garrison of locally trained men who constitute a militia. {#1}Sergeants{/#1} that have been promoted can lead a company of few of these men as Captains. Oftentimes they enjoy some other advantages and can expect to live a few more years than grunt soldiers.
units.zh: 小城镇通常保有一支由当地受训居民组成的民兵。晋升后的{#1}军士{/#1}可以担任队长，率领其中一小队人。他们往往还享有额外待遇，也有望比普通士兵多活几年。

units.source: This built is a slight variation of the {#1}Marshal{/#1} but unlike him, the Captain doesn't carry the {#2}Battle Standard{/#2}. He can still rally but will otherwise make standard attacks with its {#3}Billhook{/#3} like Billmen.
units.zh: 队长是{#1}元帅{/#1}的小幅变体，但不携带{#2}战旗{/#2}。他仍能鼓舞士气，其余时候则像钩镰枪兵一样，用{#3}钩镰{/#3}发动普通攻击。

units.source: The choice of {#1}Billhook{/#1} over any other weapon as a sole mastery is because of the range it provides while dealing very good {#2}Damage{/#2}. Without a {#3}Polearm{/#3}, the character would waste Action Points moving into range. I am aware this takes out any possibility of hitting multiple targets in one strike. So I encourage you to test other two-handed {#4}Weapons{/#4} and see what works best for your team.
units.zh: 只选{#1}钩镰{/#1}精通，是因为它兼具射程和出色的{#2}伤害{/#2}。没有{#3}长柄武器{/#3}，角色就得浪费行动点移动到攻击范围内。不过，这也失去了单次攻击多个目标的能力，因此建议尝试其他双手{#4}武器{/#4}，看看哪种更适合你的队伍。

units.source: The main difference with the {#1}Marshal{/#1} is Reach Advantage which will increase your {#2}Melee Defense{/#2} to the point where you can safely come into contact with enemies. This also provides additional coverage for your vulnerable, 'true' back line units and reduces their total number.
units.zh: 与{#1}元帅{/#1}的主要区别是长兵优势，它能提高{#2}近战防御{/#2}，使角色可以安全接敌。这也能为脆弱的真正后排提供更多掩护，并减少队伍中必须一直待在后排的人数。

units.source: Duelists focus their training on a restricted number of weapons. Instead of wielding shields and heavier or additional sets they keep a single weapon in hand. This allows for increased dexterity and power though this comes at the cost of defensive abilities.
units.zh: 决斗者专精少数武器，只在手中持一件武器，不带盾牌、重型备用装备或其他成套武装。这提升了灵活性与攻击威力，但也牺牲了防御能力。

units.source: There's a constant need in every {#1}Settlement{/#1} for small business owners, traders and merchants. But Butchers have known a remarkable increase in their number these past few years. One can surely understand that when you know how and where to cut meat, you're prepared for anything should a war break out.
units.zh: 每处{#1}聚落{/#1}都需要小店主、行商和商人，但近年屠夫的人数增长格外明显。这倒不难理解：若清楚刀该从哪里下、肉该怎么切，一旦战争爆发，也算早有准备。

units.source: Depending on whether you want this character to face ranged units or not, you'll decide on whether to raise {#1}Ranged Defense{/#1} as a secondary {#2}Attribute{/#2} and with Veteran {#3}Levels{/#3} or not. If you decide to do so and if you also have a low {#4}Fatigue{/#4}, you may consider switching Adrenaline for another {#5}Perk{/#5}.
units.zh: 是否把{#1}远程防御{/#1}列为次要{#2}属性{/#2}，并在老兵{#3}等级{/#3}继续提升，取决于你是否打算让该角色对付远程敌人。若要提高远防，而{#4}疲劳上限{/#4}又偏低，可以考虑把肾上腺素换成其他{#5}特长{/#5}。

units.source: But Adrenaline will ensure the best possible Defense at all times if you follow these steps:
units.zh: 不过，按下面的步骤操作，肾上腺素能帮助角色始终保持尽可能好的防御：

units.source: Cleavers is arguably one of the best one-handed {#1}Weapons{/#1}.
units.zh: 斩刀可以说是最出色的单手{#1}武器{/#1}之一。

units.source: It does not only sports very good overall {#1}Damage{/#1}, it also inflicts bleeds if enough damage is dealt to {#2}Hitpoints{/#2} (10?). With {#3}Cleaver{/#3} Mastery, that's 20 {#4}Hitpoints{/#4} per hit over two turns. It essentially counters Nine Lives and finishes off otherwise surviving low {#5}Hitpoints{/#5} enemies.
units.zh: 它不仅总体{#1}伤害{/#1}出色，在造成足够{#2}生命值{/#2}伤害后还会触发流血；原文对门槛的记载为“10？”。有{#3}斩刀{/#3}精通时，每次命中带来的流血会在两回合内造成 20 点{#4}生命值{/#4}伤害，能有效克制九命，并收掉残存的低{#5}生命值{/#5}敌人。

units.source: Its basic attack, Chop, is extremely cost effective too, with only 9 {#1}Fatigue{/#1} per use after Mastery.
units.zh: 基础技能“劈砍”的效率也很高，拥有精通后，每次只需积累 9 点{#1}疲劳{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}Cleaver{/#1} Mastery also works with {#2}Orc Cleavers{/#2}, a stronger version of normal {#3}Cleavers{/#3} with additional {#4}Fatigue{/#4} costs.
units.zh: {#1}斩刀{/#1}精通也适用于{#2}兽人斩刀{/#2}。它比普通{#3}斩刀类{/#3}威力更强，但{#4}疲劳{/#4}消耗也更高。

units.source: All kinds of {#1}Brigands{/#1}, Thugs and shady characters roam the land and soil civilized cities with their less than honest dealings. Why work and sweat your blood for a mere pittance and such a reward as 'honorable' living if you can get rich by other, more direct means? Brutes do not care about those. They get what they want, should they have to axe a skull or two.
units.zh: 各类{#1}强盗{/#1}、打手和可疑人物游荡四方，用不光彩的勾当玷污城镇。既然有更直接的发财办法，何必流血流汗，只换来微薄收入和“体面生活”的名声？蛮横之徒才不在乎这些。他们想要什么就拿什么，哪怕要劈开几颗脑袋。

units.source: Brutes are {#1}Duelists{/#1} with the Brute {#2}Trait{/#2}. Since Brute gives increased {#3}Damage{/#3} on head (critical) hits it synergies well with {#4}Backgrounds{/#4} that have increased chance to hit head like Killers on the Run or with {#5}Weapons{/#5} that increase that same chance like {#6}Flails{/#6}. Unfortunately, these are not as viable as other options for late game. {#7}Axes{/#7} however, deal substantial {#8}Damage{/#8} especially to {#9}Armor{/#9} which is essential and they also add another 50% damage on head hits.
units.zh: 蛮力者是具备蛮力{#2}特性{/#2}的{#1}决斗者{/#1}。蛮力提高头部暴击的{#3}伤害{/#3}，因此适合搭配在逃杀人犯等提高爆头率的{#4}背景{/#4}，或{#6}连枷类{/#6}等提高爆头率的{#5}武器{/#5}。不过，原文认为这些选择在后期不如其他方案；{#7}斧类{/#7}则有可观的{#8}伤害{/#8}，尤其擅长打击关键的{#9}护甲{/#9}，命中头部时还额外增加 50% 伤害。

units.source: Combined with Brute and {#1}Axe{/#1}, Head Hunter which is otherwise hard to bank upon, makes an ideal final {#2}Perk{/#2} for increased one-hit critical kills.
units.zh: 搭配蛮力和{#1}斧{/#1}后，通常不太可靠的猎头者便成了理想的最后一项{#2}特长{/#2}，有助于增加一击暴击击杀的机会。

units.source: Since Adrenaline is not a pick on this build, {#1}Fatigue{/#1} is not so much of a concern as it is to the {#2}Butcher{/#2} unless you plan on wielding an {#3}Orc Axe{/#3} (which is not as good as {#4}Orc Cleavers{/#4} are in comparison to their respective normal versions). It means you can go for {#5}Ranged Defense{/#5} as a secondary {#6}Attribute{/#6} and with Veteran {#7}Levels{/#7}.
units.zh: 这套方案不选肾上腺素，所以{#1}疲劳上限{/#1}不像{#2}屠夫{/#2}方案那样紧张，除非打算使用{#3}兽人斧{/#3}。与各自的普通版本相比，兽人斧的提升不如{#4}兽人斩刀{/#4}明显。因此，可以把{#5}远程防御{/#5}作为次要{#6}属性{/#6}，并在老兵{#7}等级{/#7}继续提高。

units.source: The main difference with {#1}Butchers{/#1} is that thanks to the {#2}Axe{/#2} Mastery, you get to keep a {#3}Longaxe{/#3} in your bag for more combat versatility.
units.zh: 与{#1}屠夫{/#1}方案的主要区别是，有了{#2}斧{/#2}精通，可以在背包中携带{#3}长柄斧{/#3}，增加战术选择。

units.source: Swordmasters have reached such skill and fame with their named swords that they're often very sought after even by kings. They are adept at finding openings no common fighters would think of and strike {#1}Knights{/#1} in full plate armor like cats a mouse: with deadly accuracy and utmost apparent childish ease. They also develop secret techniques to parry blows and counter attacks against all expectations.
units.zh: 剑术大师凭借精湛剑术与手中的名剑声名远扬，连国王也求贤若渴。他们能找到普通战士想不到的破绽，对付全身板甲的{#1}骑士{/#1}，就像猫捉老鼠一般精准致命、举重若轻。他们还掌握秘密技法，能在出人意料之时招架并反击。

units.source: These {#1}Swordmasters{/#1} specialize in the {#2}Direwolf{/#2} school or style. The recipients of such a well kept knowledge are extremely rare and must often pass a series of daunting challenges to deserve a training. Almost nothing is known of who they are and the persons who would met an untimely death.
units.zh: 这些{#1}剑术大师{/#1}专修{#2}恐狼{/#2}流派。获授此等秘技的人极其稀少，通常必须通过一连串艰难考验才有资格受训。他们的身份几乎无人知晓，探寻秘密的人则往往早早丧命。

units.source: The Swordmaster {#1}Background{/#1} is not recommended for this build since Old with reduce Nimble chance to activate by 20%.
units.zh: 不推荐用剑术大师{#1}背景{/#1}培养此配装，因为年迈会使旧版轻灵的触发概率降低 20%。

units.source: Nimble has natural affinity with Dodge ({#1}Fatigue{/#1} penalties negatively affect {#2}Initiative{/#2}) which raises both {#3}Melee Defense{/#3} and {#4}Ranged Defense{/#4}. This build improves on it by raising them equally on level-up. It is fine to do so, since {#5}Fatigue{/#5} isn't much needed with light {#6}Armor{/#6} and {#7}Swords{/#7}.
units.zh: 轻灵与闪避天然契合：{#1}疲劳{/#1}惩罚会降低{#2}先攻{/#2}，而闪避则随先攻提高{#3}近战防御{/#3}和{#4}远程防御{/#4}。这套方案在升级时同时提高两项防御，进一步强化优势。由于使用轻型{#6}护甲{/#6}和{#7}剑类{/#7}，对{#5}疲劳上限{/#5}需求不高，这样分配也行得通。

units.source: Lone Wolf is another great {#1}Perk{/#1} to have on {#2}Swordmasters{/#2}. While distancing yourself from your party is generally a bad idea, {#3}Swordmasters{/#3} thrive on it. It's when they get surrounded that the {#4}Sword{/#4} Riposte skill will work best. Be very careful about {#5}Morale{/#5} drop though. If your {#6}Resolve{/#6} is too low, consider wearing the {#7}Sergeants Sash{/#7}.
units.zh: 孤狼是{#2}剑术大师{/#2}的另一项优秀{#1}特长{/#1}。通常不应远离队伍，但{#3}剑术大师{/#3}能从中获益：被敌人包围时，{#4}剑{/#4}的还击架势最能发挥作用。不过，要格外提防{#5}士气{/#5}下降；若{#6}意志{/#6}不足，可以考虑佩戴{#7}军士腰带{/#7}。

units.zh: 可为战团招募另一名荒野人并获得食物，或获得一条战犬和一只猎鹰。 ({#1}被囚禁的荒野人{/#1})

units.source: You can risk taking his crowns away. ({#1}Wildman Testing Money{/#1})
units.zh: 你可以冒险拿走他的克朗。 ({#1}荒野人试验钱币{/#1})

units.source: Can suffer {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} light wounds and 50% of your men get a {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} good mood. ({#7}Sellsword vs Bees{/#7})

+20 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} at morale checks against fear, panic or mind-control effects.

units.zh: 可用 1 颗锯齿獠牙制作解毒剂。 ({#1}猎巫人与食尸鬼牙齿{/#1})

units.source: May prevent a fight, gain you 1 shimmering ashes and get a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} good mood. ({#4}Undead Necrosavant{/#4})
units.zh: 可能避免一场战斗，为战团获得 1 份微光灰烬，并 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}心情改善。 ({#4}亡灵灾祸：死灵剑士{/#4})

units.source: Will get a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} bad mood if you set the alp free. ({#4}Alp Captured in a Hole{/#4})

units.zh: 可能目睹聚落居民被活活烧死。 ({#1}遭受火刑的女巫{/#1})
