units.zh: 与基础游戏相比，安装的 DLC 可能改变某些背景的招募概率。不过，相较于城镇状况、建筑或附属地点的影响，这类变化通常很小，或仅限于特定地形的城市、村庄和堡垒。

units.source: {#1}{#2}↑{/#2}{/#1} {#3}{#4}Attachments (when not destroyed), buildings and situations add additional entries to the list of character backgrounds from which new recruits are randomly chosen. +1 means that the chance to see such characters available for recruitment was increased by roughly 2-3%/3-5%/6-8,5% for large/medium/small settlements respectively. +2 means 2 times that increase etc.{/#4}{/#3}
units.zh: {#1}{#2}↑{/#2}{/#1} {#3}{#4}未被摧毁的附属地点、建筑和当地状况，会向随机生成新兵所用的背景名单中添加条目。+1 表示该背景的招募出现率提高：大型聚落约 2-3%，中型约 3-5%，小型约 6-8,5%（原文用逗号作小数点）。+2 表示提升幅度为前者的 2 倍，依此类推。{/#4}{/#3}

units.source: {#1}This guide is meant for relatively new players. For a more in-depth guide aimed at slightly more experienced players, see {#2}Game Guide{/#2}.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}本指南面向刚接触游戏的玩家。若已有一些经验，想深入了解，请参阅{#2}游戏指南{/#2}。{/#1}

units.source: Battle Brothers puts you in the shoes of the leader of a mercenary band in the lands of medieval Germany. You'll find yourself pitted against noble armies, fighting raiding barbarians, beating back the pillaging greenskins, ridding the land of monstrous beasts, and outwitting the nefarious mystical beings of yore--all in the name of coin. If you live long enough in this profession, you and your company might even see yourselves with a bit of hard-earned fame from the townsfolk, and possibly even some begrudging respect from the nobles. Which you won't much care about, because you'll be too busy counting stacks and stacks of coins.
units.zh: 《战场兄弟》让你扮演佣兵团长，在以中世纪德意志为原型的土地上讨生活。你会与贵族军队交战，抵御蛮族和绿皮劫掠，猎杀怪兽，与古老邪物周旋——一切都是为了克朗。若能在这行活得够久，战团也许会在城镇居民间闯出名声，甚至让贵族勉强生出几分敬意。不过，你大概顾不上这些，因为你正忙着数一堆又一堆的钱币。

units.source: Alright, enough with the flavor text and on to the guide!
units.zh: 背景故事就说到这里，开始介绍怎么玩吧！

units.source: There's a handful of important resources to keep an eye on as the leader of your company. Make sure you stock up on them when you see a good price.
units.zh: 身为团长，有几种重要资源需要时刻留意。遇到好价格时，记得补充库存。

units.source: {#1}Crowns{/#1} - Get more of it by selling goods and equipment, and completing contracts. If you run out of it and brothers don't get paid midday, they won't be happy about it.
units.zh: {#1}克朗{/#1}——出售货物、装备和完成委托都能赚钱。若钱花光了，弟兄们中午领不到工资，可不会高兴。

units.source: {#1}{#2}Provisions{/#2}{/#1} - Stock up before you hit the road, and find a few morsels after most battles. Almost all food will spoil after a time, but luckily your brothers aren't too picky and will always eat the food that has the least life left to it first. That said, they won't like it if you run out of food completely. As you pass through villages, if you see staples like ground grains, bread, and roots and berries for {#3}60g-70g{/#3}, snap them up.
units.zh: {#1}{#2}口粮{/#2}{/#1}——上路前要备足，多数战斗后也能找到一些。几乎所有食物都会腐坏，好在弟兄们不挑食，总会先吃最接近变质的那份。但若彻底断粮，他们就会不满。经过村庄时，看到谷粉、面包或根茎与浆果这类主食卖 {#3}60-70 克朗{/#3}，就可以买下。

units.source: {#1}Tools{/#1} - Used to keep equipment in shape. Tools are probably the resource you'll find yourself managing the most, as you use them after every fight for your own equipment and you can use them to get the most for equipment you want to sell. A good price is {#2}200g-250g{/#2} for a stack of tools, but early on you might find yourself settling for 270g.
units.zh: {#1}工具{/#1}——用于维护装备，可能是你最需要精打细算的资源。每场战斗后都要用它修理自用装备，也能拿来修复准备出售的战利品，提高售价。一组工具卖 {#2}200-250 克朗{/#2}算好价格；前期可能不得不接受 270 克朗。

units.source: {#1}Ammunition{/#1} - When you shoot arrows or hurl throwing weapons, you use ammo to replenish them. {#2}80g-100g{/#2} is a good deal.
units.zh: {#1}弹药{/#1}——射箭或投掷武器后，需要消耗弹药储备补充。{#2}80-100 克朗{/#2}算划算。

units.source: {#1}Medicine{/#1} - When a brother is injured, their injury will take a range of days to recover, using up a unit of medicine every day. It can be pretty expensive, so while you shouldn't run out of medicine, new companies might not want to overstock it. {#2}180g-220g{/#2} are good and reasonable prices.
units.zh: {#1}医疗物资{/#1}——弟兄受伤后，需要若干天恢复，每天消耗一单位医疗物资。这类补给不便宜，因此既别断货，新战团也不必囤太多。{#2}180-220 克朗{/#2}属于合理的好价格。

units.source: So now that you have your boots on the ground, what should your short-term goals be? Generally speaking, a new company should prioritize
units.zh: 站稳脚跟后，短期该追求什么？一般来说，新战团应优先做好以下几件事：

units.source: {#1}{#2}Complete ambitions.{/#2}{/#1} Above all else, completing ambitions as fast as possible will propel you forward. You'll get more money when selling equipment, be offered better contracts, and sometimes be rewarded with unique equipment. Pick ambitions you can easily complete, and do so asap.
units.zh: {#1}{#2}完成战团抱负。{/#2}{/#1}尽快完成抱负最能推动战团成长：出售装备能赚更多钱，可以接到更好的委托，有时还能获得独特装备。优先选择容易完成的抱负，尽早达成。

units.source: {#1}{#2}Stabilize your war chest{/#2}{/#1} so you can take advantage of good deals when you see them, hire better recruits, and stock up on supplies to support some extended adventuring. In the very early game you'll have to spend money to make money and balancing the scale can be tough, but once you have some fighting men outfitted with basic equipment, aim to keep at least 5k on hand.
units.zh: {#1}{#2}留足周转资金。{/#2}{/#1}这样遇到便宜货时才买得起，也能雇用更好的新兵、囤足补给，支持较长时间的冒险。开局往往得先花钱才能赚钱，收支平衡并不容易；但有了一批装备基本齐全的战士后，就应争取手头至少常备 5 千克朗。

units.source: {#1}{#2}Get better armor.{/#2}{/#1} Armor makes a huge impact in the early and mid game. You can double, triple, or even quadruple a brother's effective health with armor. When outfitting your first gaggle of men, you might have to buy a few pieces of cloth, but after that it's probably more effective to take it off of enemy corpses. To do so, you'll need to kill your enemies without wrecking their armor. There's a few tricks for this:
units.zh: {#1}{#2}换上更好的护甲。{/#2}{/#1}护甲在前中期作用很大，能让弟兄的有效承伤能力翻到两倍、三倍，甚至四倍。最初招人时，或许得先买几件布甲；之后从敌人尸体上取甲通常更划算。要完整缴获，就得尽量在不破坏护甲的情况下杀死敌人，可以采用下面几种办法：

units.source: First, using knives with the Puncture attack to do direct hp damage. It's risky to do this, so a common technique is to pick an enemy target at the beginning of the battle, stick a guy with a shield to them, and only spam shieldwall to tie him up while the rest of your company clears out the rest of the rabble. As brothers free up, peel them off to surround your target so that when he decides to flee he won't be able to move at all. Swap to knives and puncture him down.
units.zh: 第一，用小刀的穿刺技能直接伤害生命值。这有一定风险，因此常见做法是开战时选定目标，让一名持盾弟兄贴住他，反复开盾墙拖延；其余人先解决其他敌人，再逐步围住目标，让他即使溃逃也无路可走，最后换小刀穿刺击杀。

units.source: Second, using flails with the Lash attack to only hit the helmet so you can net the body armor. Flails are honestly pretty great weapons in the early and mid game due to this and their good matchup against shields, so acquiring a couple of them is a good strategy. Handing a pair reasonably gifted front liners some flails and letting them lash away on some poor raiders can net you plenty of light and medium armor.
units.zh: 第二，用连枷的抽击技能专打头部，保住身体护甲。连枷在前中期很好用，既便于缴甲，又擅长对付盾牌，因此值得弄几把。给几名资质不错的前排配上连枷，盯着强盗劫掠者的脑袋打，就能收获不少轻甲和中甲。

units.source: {#1}{#2}Acquire and train good brothers.{/#2}{/#1} Although the previous goals are certainly more pressing as you start your company, the main goal through all of it is to assemble a strong company of warriors. More on this a bit later.
units.zh: {#1}{#2}招募并培养优秀弟兄。{/#2}{/#1}虽然开局时前几项目标更迫切，但贯穿整个战役的核心目标，始终是建立一支强大的战士队伍。稍后再详细讨论。

units.source: Being a savvy shopper and a crafty salesman can net you some good coin. Contracts certainly aren't everything when it comes to making money. Here's a few important mechanics to be aware of.
units.zh: 会买也会卖，才能赚到更多克朗。赚钱绝不只靠委托，下面几项机制值得了解。

units.source: {#1}Cities and Relations {/#1}- Cities that like you will give you better prices. Way better prices. Doing local contracts for towns raises your relations with them, but over time your relations with everyone will naturally move towards neutral. A suggestion is to pick a medium-sized village or a city that's near the wilds and make it your home base. Plan your movements to pass by often, and always take reasonable contracts there. Soon you'll always get the best prices there out of most settlements, and when you victoriously come back from the wilds with a wagon chock-full of loot, your efforts will literally pay off.
units.zh: {#1}城市与关系{/#1}——喜欢你的城市会开出更好的价格，而且差距相当明显。完成当地委托能改善关系，但所有关系都会随时间逐渐回归中立。建议选一座靠近荒野的中型村庄或城市作为据点，规划路线时经常经过，顺便接下合理的委托。用不了多久，这里就会成为价格最好的交易点之一；等你从荒野凯旋，拖着满车战利品回来，之前的经营就能变成实实在在的收入。

units.source: {#1}Repairing before selling{/#1} - When you loot equipment from enemies, it will probably be roughed up a bit. Depending on the item, it may be worth it for you to repair it before you sell it. Many players have done the calculations, made the spreadsheets, and have determined rules you should follow... and so have I! But honestly, all those tables and complexities can be summed up with this one simple rule of thumb:
units.zh: {#1}修好再卖{/#1}——缴获的装备大多有些破损，某些物品值得先修复再出售。不少玩家算过账、做过表，总结出各种规则，我也不例外。不过，大量计算最后可以归纳为这条简单经验：

units.source: If the current durability is less than 10% of the {#1}Worth{/#1} of the item, repairing it will be effective.
units.zh: 如果当前耐久数值低于物品当前{#1}价值{/#1}的 10%，先修再卖通常有利可图。

units.source: Let's get some quick example numbers: A Scramasax at 34 durability is worth 425g. You repair that. Why, you ask? Well, if you sold it now at a friendly town (18%), you'd get 76g for it. If you repaired it with reasonably priced tools (260g), you'd come out ahead by 30g. That's almost 40% more for your efforts!
units.zh: 举个例子：一把耐久为 34、当前价值 425 克朗的撒克逊短刀，值得修理。在关系友好的城镇按 18% 收购比例直接卖出，只能得到 76 克朗；若用价格合理的工具（260 克朗一组）修好再卖，净收益可多出 30 克朗，几乎增加 40%！

units.source: {#1}Trade goods{/#1} - Depending on the attached locations, many settlements will produce an excess of goods that you can buy for cheap and sell for a profit at larger cities (or your "home base"). Some of these goods include gems, dyes, copper, and lumber, but even expensive foods such as venison, ham, or wine can make a fine trade good if a settlement produces them. Beware, though: you're a mercenary band--and believe it or not, spilling blood pays better than spilling wine. Augment your economics with trading--it's the cherry on top.
units.zh: {#1}贸易货物{/#1}——许多聚落会因附属地点而盛产某些货物，你可以低价买入，运到大城市或自己的据点出售。宝石、染料、铜和木材都是常见选择；若当地盛产鹿肉、火腿或葡萄酒，这些昂贵食物也能用于贸易。不过，你毕竟是一支佣兵团，流血通常比卖酒更赚钱。把贸易当成额外收入即可。

units.source: {#1}Ambushed trade routes{/#1} - Sometimes you'll find that a settlement has the "Ambushed Trade Routes" situation. Under this effect, all items are traded for a higher value. If you find a city that has this effect, you might want to hold off on completing their contracts to drive off bandits or beasts so you can take advantage of their dire situation. You're a mercenary after all, and where there's strife, there's extra coin. Note that there are other {#2}situations{/#2} that yield similar trade benefits to watch out for.
units.zh: {#1}商路遇袭{/#1}——某些聚落会出现这一状况，使所有物品的交易价格上涨。如果在城市遇上，可以暂缓完成驱逐强盗或野兽的委托，利用当前高价出售货物。佣兵嘛，有纷争就有额外财路。其他一些{#2}当地状况{/#2}也有类似的贸易收益，值得留意。

units.source: {#1}Always be fighting{/#1} - What's the best way to make money, you ask? Fighting. Nabbing a weapon from the cold grasp of your vanquished opponent is worth more than you'll make on buying and selling some mead... and hey, he's probably wearing some armor you can sell for a pretty penny too. Really, trading and contracts are nice and everything, but they're just extra. Looting equipment and valuables is actually where the money is at in Battle Brothers, so always be looking for a fight.
units.zh: {#1}持续作战{/#1}——最好的赚钱办法就是战斗。从败敌冰冷的手中取下武器，往往比倒卖几桶蜜酒更赚钱；他身上的护甲也许还能再卖一笔。贸易和委托固然不错，但真正的大头是缴获装备和财宝，因此要不断寻找合适的战斗机会。

units.source: As you visit towns you'll be offered contracts as a mercenary for hire. Local contracts are fair money, but mostly they provide you with an opportunity to double up on your time as you're looking for fights while getting paid for it. With enough renown, noble contracts will become available, and those are often quite lucrative. Not all contracts are easy money though, and some are just not worth your time.
units.zh: 到访城镇时，会有人雇你执行委托。地方委托报酬尚可，更大的好处是让寻找战斗和领取报酬一举两得。声望足够后，还能接到通常更赚钱的贵族委托。不过，并非所有委托都划算，有些实在不值得耗费时间。

units.source: Escort caravan - Unless the destination is nearby or you're trying to buy named gear, this contract takes too long. You also can't take extra fights on your way.
units.zh: 护送商队——除非目的地很近，或你正打算购买名贵装备，否则往往太耗时，途中也无法主动找额外战斗。

units.source: Deliver item - The pay is bad and there's no fighting involved. Only take if it's close and you're heading that direction anywhere.
units.zh: 递送物品——报酬低，也没有战斗可打。只有路程近、又正好顺路时才值得接。

units.source: Discover location - Avoid. Abort. Don't take. It's a royal pain to find these locations, and the region they are supposed to be in can be quite deceptive.
units.zh: 发现地点——作者建议避开。这类地点可能很难找，任务提到的区域名称也容易令人判断失误。

units.source: Big Game Hunt (Noble) - Unless you need the beast trophies, often times the pay isn't enough to warrant fighting the more troublesome beasts. Also, if the region is far away, the groups of beasts may have dispersed when you get there and they can be hard to track down.
units.zh: 大型狩猎（贵族）——除非需要相应的野兽战利品，否则报酬往往不值得去惹那些麻烦的怪兽。若目标区域很远，赶到时兽群可能早已分散，追踪起来也困难。

units.source: Escort Envoy (Noble) - If it's not nearby, this contract takes too long, and there's rarely fights involved. You also have to sit around and wait for the envoy at the destination for half a day.
units.zh: 护送使者（贵族）——目的地不近时，任务太耗时，而且很少有战斗；到了地方还得等使者半天。

units.source: Destroy an enemy camp - A quick camp fight? What's not to like.
units.zh: 摧毁敌营——迅速打下一处营地，何乐而不为。

units.source: Return a stolen item - Another quick fight? Easy money (and renown!).
units.zh: 追回失物——又是一场快仗，轻松赚钱，还能赚声望。

units.source: Hunt beasts around the settlement - Sometimes the beasts move pretty fast and are hard to track down, but generally you can find the fight pretty quickly.
units.zh: 猎杀聚落周围的野兽——有时野兽移动很快，难以追上，但多数情况下很快就能开打。

units.source: Patrol (Noble) - Here's a real opportunity for optimization. Fighting bandits or beasts on the road count towards your head count, but so does fighting enemy camps. Getting paid to take camps is pretty nice! On top of that, settlements that you patrol get the Safe Roads situation, which gives some solid buffs including more shop item availability.
units.zh: 巡逻（贵族）——这是提高收益的好机会。路上的强盗、野兽算人头，营地里的敌人也算，相当于拿着额外赏金打营地。巡逻过的聚落还可能获得道路安全状况，带来商品供应增加等好处。

units.source: A note on contract negotiations: the only choice that is even marginally worth it is the top choice, "We need to be paid more for this." And only {#1}once{/#1} per contract. You can get a 3% to 10% raise by doing so, but you also sacrifice a small amount of faction relationship every time you ask. Because relations are so valuable for trade prices, you probably don't want to do this at settlements that you find yourself doing a lot of business at.
units.zh: 关于议价：原文作者认为，只有最上面的“这活得加钱”稍有尝试价值，而且每份委托最多只提{#1}一次{/#1}。原文记载可加薪 3% 至 10%，但每次开口都会损失少量势力关系。关系对交易价格很有价值，因此在经常做生意的聚落，最好别随意讨价还价。

units.source: Each settlement has a separate set of price modifiers for items.
units.zh: 每处聚落都有各自的物品价格系数。

units.source: All regular items (weapons/armor) are sold at the same fraction of their worth, which is the selling price modifier for that settlement. Price modifiers are expressed as a percentage of its worth: ie a Full Helm is worth 3500, if it sells for 689G in a settlement, we know the selling price modifier in that settlement is more than 19.686% (689/3500) and less than 19.714% (690/3500) as prices are truncated. Selling price modifiers are a good deal higher for treasure items (prices about equal to worth are common) and trade goods (prices often higher than worth).
units.zh: 普通物品，如武器和护甲，均按自身价值的同一比例卖出，这就是该聚落的出售价格系数。系数表示售价占物品价值的百分比。例如，全覆面盔价值 3500，若在某聚落卖价为 689 克朗，由于价格会截去小数，该地出售系数便介于 19.686%（689/3500）与 19.714%（690/3500）之间。宝物和贸易货物的出售系数更高：宝物售价常接近自身价值，贸易货物则常高于自身价值。

units.source: Similarly, there is a buying price modifier for each settlement, which determines buying prices for all regular items for that settlement. Example, a Marketplace in a Castle settlement selling a Militia Spear (worth 180) for 200 would have a buying price modifier of 1.11. Trade goods purchase also use the same buying price modifier. Supplies (tools/medicine/ammo) purchase generally also use the same buying price modifier, but in some settlements, buying prices can be {#1}1.5x{/#1} of what is expected. If a settlement has an attached location that produces the item in question (ie Arrow-Maker Shed produces Ammo, Wheat Fields produce Ground Grains), it will be unusually low in price.
units.zh: 同样，每处聚落也有买入价格系数，用于决定普通物品的购买价格。例如，某城堡市场以 200 克朗出售价值 180 的民兵矛，则买入系数约为 1.11。贸易货物通常也使用这一系数，工具、医疗物资和弹药等补给一般亦然；但某些聚落的补给买价可能达到预计值的{#1}1.5 倍{/#1}。若聚落有生产该物品的附属地点，例如制箭棚生产弹药、麦田生产谷粉，相关物品就会特别便宜。

units.source: Buying price modifiers are correlated with selling price modifiers for any given settlement. Essentially, settlements with high buying price modifiers will also have high selling price modifiers, ditto for low price modifiers.{#1/} Example: On Veteran economic difficulty, a Stronghold where Tools can be bought for 244G (buying price modifier = 244/200 = 1.22), also gives 329G for selling a Warbrand (selling price modifier = 329/1800 = 0.1828). Another settlement, a Village may have cheaper Tools at 208G (buying modifier 1.04), but only gives 280G for Warbrands (selling modifier 0.1556). Buying price modifier/Selling price modifier = 6.67 (approx) in both cases. And this ratio applies to all settlements when playing on Veteran difficulty (all other factors being equal: Neutral (50) Relations, no settlement situation modifiers).{#2/} Expert Economic difficulty has a higher ratio (approx 7.41) due to lower Selling price modifiers.
units.zh: 同一聚落的买入和出售系数相互关联：买价系数高的地方，卖价系数通常也高，低价聚落则相反。{#1/}例如，在老练经济难度下，某要塞的工具售价为 244 克朗，买入系数 = 244/200 = 1.22；这里出售长刃战刀可得 329 克朗，出售系数 = 329/1800 = 0.1828。另一座村庄的工具只需 208 克朗，买入系数为 1.04，但长刃战刀只能卖 280 克朗，出售系数为 0.1556。两地的“买入系数 ÷ 出售系数”都约为 6.67。在老练难度、其他条件相同，即关系中立（50）且无当地状况修正时，这一比值适用于所有聚落。{#2/}专家经济难度的出售系数更低，因此这一比值更高，约为 7.41。

units.source: Assuming Expert economic difficulty, for settlements at Neutral relations, with no settlement situation modifiers, selling price modifier for regular items (weapons/armor/pelts/fangs) usually ranges from 12.82% to 17.69% over various settlements.
units.zh: 在专家经济难度下，若关系中立且无当地状况修正，各聚落对普通物品（武器、护甲、毛皮、獠牙）的出售系数通常介于 12.82% 和 17.69% 之间。

units.source: Selling price modifiers for treasure (signet ring/silverware/gemstones) and trade items (cloth rolls/quality wood/amber/salt) increase proportionally with price modifiers for regular items and are about 6.33x and 7.48x respectively.
units.zh: 宝物，如印戒、银器和宝石，以及贸易货物，如布卷、优质木材、琥珀和盐，其出售系数均随普通物品系数同比增加，分别约为后者的 6.33 倍和 7.48 倍。

units.source: For example, increasing Relations from 50 to 100 will improve selling price modifiers for regular items in a City Hall from 17.69% to 19.69%. The same increase in Relations improves selling price modifiers for treasure items from 112.0% to 124.8% (112.0/17.69 = 124.8/19.69 = 6.33)
Selling and buying prices in settlements are generally dependent on a few factors (economic difficulty, settlement type/size, settlement Relations, settlement situation)
units.zh: 聚落的买入和出售价格主要取决于经济难度、聚落类型与规模、聚落关系，以及当地状况。

units.source: 1)Economic difficulty - this is set by the player before the start of any campaign and affects selling prices, with Expert naturally having lower selling prices compared to Beginner/Veteran. For example, on Veteran, base selling price modifiers for City Halls are 18.73% - 19.61%. On Expert the corresponding range is 16.88% - 17.69%.
units.zh: 1）经济难度：在战役开始前选择，会影响出售价格。专家难度的卖价自然低于初学者或老练。例如，老练难度下城市的基础出售系数为 18.73% - 19.61%，专家难度则为 16.88% - 17.69%。

units.source: {#1/} 2)Settlement type/size - this determines the base price modifiers for each settlement and are quite variable.{#2/} They can be grossly grouped into 3 'price modifier brackets' (High, Medium, Low). Assuming Expert economic difficulty, no Relation modifiers (Relation 50) and no Settlement situation modifiers:
units.zh: {#1/}2）聚落类型与规模：决定每处聚落的基础价格系数，差异较大。{#2/}大致可分为高、中、低 3 档。下表假定为专家经济难度，无关系修正，即关系为 50，也无当地状况修正：

units.source: {#1/} The table above shows that City Halls generally give the best base selling prices while Village Halls and Fortified Manors generally have the cheapest buying prices. Within the same bracket, settlements with more attached locations tend to have higher prices than those which have less. {#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}1{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2} Typical numbers of attached locations and corresponding price modifiers are shown in the table above.{#6/} There are sometimes a few discrepancies over time, due to locations being rebuilt (from ruins) or getting destroyed in raids. Ruins do not count as an attached location until rebuilt. Generally base price modifiers for a given settlement stay constant over the course of a campaign, all other factors below being equal.
units.zh: {#1/}上表显示，城市通常给出最高的基础出售价格，村庄和设防庄园的买价则通常最低。同一价格档内，附属地点越多，价格往往越高。{#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}1{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2}表中列出了常见附属地点数量及对应系数。{#6/}附属地点从废墟中重建，或在劫掠中被摧毁，可能使价格随时间变化。废墟在重建前不计为附属地点。一般而言，若下面其他因素不变，同一聚落的基础价格系数会在战役中保持稳定。

units.source: {#1/} 3)Settlement relations - doing contracts for a settlement improves Relations (starts at Neutral(50) and is capped at Allied (100)).{#2/} On Expert difficulty, the maximum increase is about "2% of worth" for selling price modifiers and this appears to be factored in additively as opposed to settlement situation modifiers. For example, a City Hall may start at 17.69% selling price modifier at 50 Relations. This improves to 19.69% at 100 Relations. A Village Hall would start lower at 13.64% selling price modifier at 50 Relations. This improves to 15.64% at 100 Relations.
units.zh: {#1/}3）聚落关系：完成当地委托可改善关系，起点为中立（50），上限为盟友（100）。{#2/}在专家难度下，出售系数最多提高约物品价值的 2%，此修正似乎以加法计入，与当地状况的乘算不同。例如，一座城市在关系 50 时的出售系数为 17.69%，关系 100 时升至 19.69%；村庄的起点较低，关系 50 时为 13.64%，关系 100 时升至 15.64%。

units.source: On Expert difficulty, the maximum decrease is about "15% of worth" for buying price modifiers. For example, a Village Hall may start at 1.04 buying price modifier at 50 Relations, which goes down to 0.89 buying price modifier at 100 Relations. This is factored in additively as well. The rate of Relations decay is slow for regular settlements. A completed contract typically gives roughly +8 Relations and it takes about 33 days before Relations resets back to 50 (disappears from list of settlements on Factions screen).
units.zh: 专家难度下，买入系数最多降低约物品价值的 15%。例如，一座村庄在关系 50 时的买入系数为 1.04，关系 100 时降至 0.89，也是加法修正。普通聚落的关系衰减较慢，一份委托通常带来约 +8 关系，大约经过 33 天才会回到 50，并从势力界面的聚落关系列表中消失。

units.source: {#1/} 4)Settlement situation - discussed in more detail {#2}here{/#2}{#3/} These are applied multiplicatively on price modifiers after Relations has been factored in. For example, a City Hall at 100 Relations may start with 19.69% as its selling price modifier. Ambushed Trade Routes applies a further 10% and increases selling price modifier to 21.66% (19.69*1.1).{#4/} In brief, favorable statuses for selling items: Ambushed Trade Routes (10%), Safe Roads (9%), High Spirits (5%){#5/} And favorable statuses for buying items: Well Supplied (-10%), High Spirits (-5%)
units.zh: {#1/}4）当地状况：详细说明见{#2}这里{/#2}。{#3/}先计入关系修正，再乘算当地状况的影响。例如，一座关系为 100 的城市，原出售系数为 19.69%；商路遇袭再带来 10% 提升，变为 21.66%（19.69*1.1）。{#4/}适合卖货的状况包括：商路遇袭（10%）、道路安全（9%）、精神振奋（5%）。{#5/}适合买货的状况包括：物资充足（-10%）、精神振奋（-5%）。

units.source: In the beginning the player can choose the first crisis that will happen (or leave it random). Choose wisely as Greenskin and Undead Invasions can and will destroy human settlements (when you turn on the permanent destruction) and there is no way to rebuild them.
units.zh: 开局时可以指定首次危机，也可以随机。选择时要留意：开启聚落永久摧毁后，绿皮入侵和亡灵入侵都可能毁掉人类聚落，而且无法重建。

units.source: If permanent destruction is turned off, the cities will get the specific {#1}Settlement Situations{/#1} for a while instead of being destroyed.
units.zh: 关闭永久摧毁后，城市会暂时陷入相应的{#1}城镇状况{/#1}，不会被永久毁掉。

units.source: If any crisis was chosen (specifically or random) it will be foretold around the 50th to 70th day of the campaign and start around the 80th - 100th day. There is no renown requirement for a crisis to start, but a certain amount of days need to have passed in your campaign, as well a minimum roster (determined by average level and number of men).{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}1{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: 无论指定还是随机选择危机，预兆一般出现在战役第 50 至 70 天，危机通常于第 80 - 100 天开始。启动不要求声望达到某一数值，但必须经过足够天数，且战团实力达到最低要求；实力由平均等级和人数决定。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}1{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: If the company has no {#1}ambition{/#1}, the ambition pop up will occur where the company can choose the "defeat crisis" ambition that will give the player a look into the current state of affairs (how successful or not the player is in ending the current crisis). It's not necessary to have the ambition to finish the crisis.
units.zh: 如果战团当前没有{#1}抱负{/#1}，选择界面会提供“结束危机”抱负。选取后，可查看当前局势，了解结束危机的进展。不过，即使不选这项抱负，也能平息危机。

units.source: A crisis can take from 30 to 100 days to finish although its possible to drag it even longer.
units.zh: 危机通常需要 30 至 100 天结束，也可能拖得更久。

units.source: After finishing one crisis another can happen in the span of the next 100 days (with at least 50 days of peace). The same crisis will never happen twice in a row.
units.zh: 一次危机结束后，下一次可能在随后 100 天内发生，其中至少有 50 天和平期。同一种危机不会连续发生。

units.source: The Noble Houses declare war on each other. They begin to take over rival settlements reducing those settlements supply/wealth levels without destroying them. Because this crisis doesn't destroy settlements, it's currently the suggested first crisis since it'll give your company more time to build up. While the war will finish with or without you, beware, taking one side makes the enemy side hostile which, while opening up opportunity to kill and pillage, locks you out of a significant portion of the map. Sea travel routes between Noble Houses are severed during conflict.
units.zh: 贵族家族互相宣战，攻占对方聚落，降低当地物资和财富水平，但不会摧毁聚落。原文因此推荐把贵族战争作为首次危机，为战团成长争取时间。无论是否参与，战争最终都会结束；但一旦选边，对方就会与你敌对。你虽可乘机厮杀劫掠，也会失去大片地区的通行与交易机会。冲突期间，不同贵族家族之间的海运航线也会中断。

units.source: An Ancient Evil gets awakened and allies with the Undead faction.
units.zh: 一股古老邪恶被唤醒，并与亡灵势力结盟。

units.source: Plenty of new Undead locations spawn on the map and all Undead locations have increased ratio of raiding party generation. Undead raiding parties can also have mixed units from both separate Undead factions. Dead humans also have a chance to respawn as wiedergangers.
units.zh: 地图上会出现大量新亡灵据点，所有亡灵据点生成劫掠部队的频率也会提高。劫掠队可能混编两类亡灵势力的单位，死去的人类也有机会复生为行尸。

units.source: The Undead can take over settlements and make them their own bases - destroying settlements in the process.
units.zh: 亡灵能够占领聚落，将其摧毁并改建为自己的据点。

units.source: By destroying their raiding parties and bases you assist in the effort against this crisis.
units.zh: 消灭亡灵劫掠队和据点，有助于平息这场危机。

units.source: {#1}Goblins{/#1} and {#2}Orcs{/#2} unite for one purpose - making the player's life miserable. Also to slaughter all the filthy humans, but that's not as important.
units.zh: {#1}地精{/#1}和{#2}兽人{/#2}为了同一个目标联合起来：让玩家苦不堪言。当然，也要屠尽那些肮脏的人类，不过那反倒不那么重要了。

units.source: In similar fashion of the Undead Invasion, Greenskin camps will spawn around and generate raiding parties (which lay siege to cities). Orc Warriors supported by Goblin Shamans are a force to be reckoned with.
units.zh: 与亡灵入侵类似，绿皮营地会在各地生成，并派出劫掠队围攻城市。得到地精萨满支援的兽人战士十分危险。

units.source: How do you win? Kill them all. Cities surrounded by ruins are good indicators of nearby Greenskin Cities, which you must destroy.
units.zh: 如何取胜？消灭它们。城市周围若布满废墟，往往意味着附近有绿皮大城，需要将其摧毁。

units.source: Be prepared to deal with {#1}Orc Warriors{/#1}, for they are heavily armored; {#2}hammers{/#2} are good for this purpose. Also, snipers, since Orcs are alongside {#3}Goblins{/#3}, which boast ranged units and the aforementioned {#4}Goblin Shamans{/#4} (high priority target).
units.zh: 要准备好对付重甲{#1}兽人战士{/#1}，{#2}战锤{/#2}很适合破甲。还需要优秀射手，因为兽人会与{#3}地精{/#3}并肩作战，后者拥有远程部队和前述{#4}地精萨满{/#4}，萨满应优先击杀。

units.source: Holy War is a new late game crisis added with the last Blazing Deserts dlc. It's featuring a cultural and religious conflict between northern noble houses and southern city states. It is similar to the noble war crisis but instead of capturing each others cities participants will fight for 3 holy sites trying conquer more sites than the enemy. Player can choose to side with either city states or northern crusaders by choosing specific contracts. While the fires of religious turmoil are burning the faction you will be fighting against will be hostile to you, but similar to the noble war after it's over you will have cold relations with your past enemies.
units.zh: 圣战是“烈日沙漠”DLC 新增的后期危机，围绕北方贵族家族与南方城邦之间的文化、宗教冲突展开。它与贵族战争类似，但双方争夺的不是彼此的城市，而是 3 处圣地，目标是比敌方控制更多圣地。玩家通过接取相应委托，可以支持城邦或北方十字军。战争期间，对立一方会与你敌对；结束后则与贵族战争一样，原先的敌人会恢复为冷淡关系。

units.source: Most mods for Battle Brothers can be found at {#1}Nexus Mods{/#1} or {#2}Mod DB{/#2}.{#3/}
units.zh: 《战场兄弟》的多数 MOD 可以在 {#1}Nexus Mods{/#1} 或 {#2}Mod DB{/#2} 找到。{#3/}

units.source: Modding is the process of modifying files to change the gameplay.{#1/}
units.zh: MOD 制作是通过修改文件来改变游戏内容与玩法的过程。{#1/}

units.source: Battle Brothers doesn't have official modding tools. Rather, modders use {#1}Adam Milazzo's mod kit{/#1} to decrypt and decompile the game scripts.{#2/}
units.zh: 《战场兄弟》没有官方 MOD 工具。制作者通常使用 {#1}Adam Milazzo 的 MOD 工具包{/#1}，解密并反编译游戏脚本。{#2/}

units.source: Extract the contents of the game 'data_001' archive with a file archiver like {#1}7zip{/#1}
units.zh: 用 {#1}7zip{/#1} 等压缩工具，解压游戏的 data_001 资源包。

units.source: Open a command prompt (type 'run' in the Windows search bar and enter), then type 'cmd'
units.zh: 打开命令提示符：在 Windows 搜索栏输入“运行”并回车，再输入 cmd。

units.source: Go to the kit bin directory by typing 'cd .../bbros/bin', where '...' is a path to the directory where you extracted the kit (use 'cd /d' instead of just 'cd' if the kit is located on another drive than the current one)
units.zh: 输入 cd .../bbros/bin，切换到工具包的 bin 目录；其中 ... 是解压工具包的目录路径。若工具包位于其他盘符，请用 cd /d，而非仅用 cd。

units.source: Type in 'massdecompile.bat .../data_001/scripts' where '...' is a path to the directory where you extracted 'data_001'
units.zh: 输入 massdecompile.bat .../data_001/scripts，其中 ... 是解压 data_001 的目录路径。

units.source: The scripts are now decompiled and can be opened, read and edited with a text editor. {#1}Notepad++{/#1} can add the 'data_001' folder as a workspace which comes handy for navigation and folder wide searches.{#2/}
units.zh: 反编译完成后，便可用文本编辑器打开、阅读和修改脚本。{#1}Notepad++{/#1} 可以把 data_001 文件夹加入工作区，方便浏览与跨文件搜索。{#2/}

units.source: The mod kit includes bbrusher, a program that can pack images into sprite sheets and create brushes. This is a step-by-step tutorial using the {#1}More Named Weapons mod{/#1} as an example.
units.zh: 工具包附带 bbrusher，可把图片打包为精灵图集并创建 brush 资源。下面以 {#1}More Named Weapons MOD{/#1} 为例，逐步介绍操作方法。

units.source: Access the bin folder of the mod kit following the guidelines of the {#1}Accessing the files{/#1} section
units.zh: 按照{#1}访问游戏文件{/#1}一节的说明，进入工具包的 bin 文件夹。

units.source: Orientation is north west for two-handed weapons, north east for one-handed weapons. Image size should stay close to the size of similar base game weapons (see 2. to unpack sprites).

units.zh: id 是用于引用该图标的唯一标识。

units.source: 'img' is the icon path inside the folder where metadata.xml is located
units.zh: img 是图标相对于 metadata.xml 所在文件夹的路径。

units.zh: 将生成的精灵图集添加到 preload/on_running.txt。{#1/}

units.source: Move everything in its correct location (inside the Battle Brothers data folder)
units.zh: 将所有文件放入正确位置，即《战场兄弟》的 data 文件夹内，并保持对应目录结构。

units.source: Optionally, an archive can regroup all files and folders.
units.zh: 也可以把所有文件和文件夹统一打包进压缩包。

units.zh: 其他文件同理，遵循原版目录结构与文件位置。{#1/}

Trade is conducted throughout settlements with trade caravans. It is one option for the player to get crowns besides fighting and killing, destroying enemy camps or fulfilling contracts. The player can benefit from trade simply by buying goods where they are cheap and selling them where they are expensive.
units.zh: 商队往来于各处聚落，开展贸易。除了打仗杀敌、摧毁敌方营地和完成委托，玩家也能靠贸易赚取克朗。方法很简单：在价格低的地方买入货物，再运到价格高的地方卖出。

units.source: What you basically want for trading is to have a good relationship to all towns and villages producing valuable trade goods (even some sorts of {#1}Food{/#1} can be used as trade goods but it's usually less efficient).
units.zh: 要做好贸易，首先应与出产高价值商品的城镇和村庄保持良好关系。有些{#1}食物{/#1}也能拿来倒卖，但通常利润效率较低。

units.source: The selling/buying price of goods depends on the following circumstances:
units.zh: 商品的买入价和卖出价受以下因素影响：

units.source: Is it a village or a town? Villages often produce cheaper and towns pay more for such items.{#1/}(Take note, that if a town produces the same goods as a village, the town will most likely pay a very low price for it.)
units.zh: 当地是村庄还是城镇？村庄出产的商品往往较便宜，城镇的收购价则较高。{#1/}不过，如果城镇自己也出产同种商品，通常就不会出高价收购。

units.source: Is the settlement in good shape or {#1}is something bothering it{/#1}?{#2/}Ambushed trade routes, missing villagers or other problems cause a settlement to have a reduced set of wares and/or price.
units.zh: 聚落目前安定繁荣，还是遇到了{#1}某些麻烦{/#1}？{#2/}商路遇袭、村民失踪等问题，会影响当地的货物供应和买卖价格。

units.source: Ambushed trade routes however can be used to your advantage as it raises the prices at which you sell wares too... A poorly supplied city will make you richer... but you won't find as much equipment there and it will be expensive.
units.zh: 商路遇袭也可以成为赚钱的机会，因为你出售货物的价格也会随之上涨。物资短缺的城市可能让你赚得更多，不过当地可买到的装备会减少，价格也会更高。

units.source: Is your relation with the settlement good?{#1/}Better relations grant better selling and buying prices. One ways to strengthen the relation between the player and a settlement is to successfully complete {#2}Contracts{/#2} for it.
units.zh: 你与聚落的关系好吗？{#1/}关系越好，买卖价格就越有利。为当地成功完成{#2}委托{/#2}，是改善关系的方法之一。

units.source: Some insights and findings are present {#1}here{/#1} and {#2}here{/#2}.
units.zh: 更多分析与心得可参阅{#1}这篇讨论{/#1}和{#2}这篇讨论{/#2}。

units.source: Trade goods are produced in {#1}settlements{/#1} with special {#2}attached locations{/#2}, and can be bought and sold for profit.
units.zh: 贸易商品由设有特定{#2}附属地点{/#2}的{#1}聚落{/#1}生产，玩家可以买入后转卖获利。

units.source: Trade goods can be reclaimed from enemy parties and camps or found in different events. The same can be done with {#1}Provisions{/#1} and {#2}Treasures{/#2}.
units.zh: 贸易商品也可从敌方队伍和营地中缴获，或在各种事件中获得。{#1}口粮{/#1}与{#2}财宝{/#2}同样如此。

units.source: You come across {#1}Scholar{/#1} and {#2}Dumbguy{/#2} staring at a patch of dirt. Along the brown canvas you see that {#3}Scholar{/#3} has drawn geometric shapes, letters, numbers, and what look like constellations. It appears that they've been at this for hours now.
units.zh: 你发现{#1}学者{/#1}和{#2}愚笨的队员{/#2}正盯着一块泥地。{#3}学者{/#3}把褐色的土地当作画板，在上面画了几何图形、字母、数字，还有一些像是星座的图案。看样子，他们已经在这里待了好几个钟头。

units.source: A teaching stick in hand, {#1}Scholar{/#1} madly points at one of the star clusters and demands to know what it is. {#2}Dumbguy{/#2}, with a pained expression, guesses a sheep. {#3}Scholar{/#3} snaps the teaching stick in half and kicks dirt all over his drawings. It's a horse! A horse! {#4}Scholar{/#4} sighs heavily before marching off to the beat of endless profanity. Personally, you thought it was a crab.
units.zh: {#1}学者{/#1}手持教鞭，激动地指着其中一片星群，追问那是什么。{#2}愚笨的队员{/#2}满脸为难，猜是一只羊。{#3}学者{/#3}一把折断教鞭，又踢起泥土，把自己的图画全都抹了。“是马！是马啊！”{#4}学者{/#4}重重叹了口气，一路骂骂咧咧地走开了。说实话，你原本觉得那像只螃蟹。

units.source: {#1}You find {#2}Scholar{/#2} standing over {#3}Dumbguy{/#3}. Count the beetles, don't smash them, the learned man says with exasperation. {#4}Dumbguy{/#4} looks down at his beetle-juiced hands where {#5}{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}fragments of insect carapaces{/#9}{#10}carapaces of once-insects{/#10}{/#5} dot his flesh. He nods, understandingly, and turns to pulling the beetles' legs off instead. {#11}Scholar{/#11} lets out a string of swears you've never heard in your life.{/#1}{#12}You find {#13}Scholar{/#13} and {#14}Dumbguy{/#14} yelling at one another. It appears they're at a very red-faced crossroads. {#15}Dumbguy{/#15} says he doesn't care if he's dumb, and the {#16}Scholar{/#16} argues that every man should be learned. Well it appears {#17}Dumbguy{/#17} would prefer to be left to his devices for he shows {#18}Scholar{/#18} his back as he walks away. Guess that's the end of the lesson for both men.{/#12}{#19}You find {#20}Dumbguy{/#20} squatting beside a creek, staring at himself in the shimmering reflection. He must have been at it for a while now for he's showing signs of sunburn. You ask if everything is alright, to which he explains that he is not 'getting it' with {#21}Scholar{/#21}'s teachings, and that {#22}Scholar{/#22} nearly went mad today before finally giving up on the venture. You explain that {#23}Dumbguy{/#23} doesn't have to be smart, he just needs to know how to swing a sword and shoot a bow. That's what you hired him for, after all. The man tries to hide a smile, but the running water betrays him. You take him back to camp where you then tell {#24}Scholar{/#24} to lay off for a while.{/#19}
units.zh: {#1}你看见{#2}学者{/#2}站在{#3}愚笨的队员{/#3}面前，气急败坏地说：“让你数甲虫，不是捏死它们！”{#4}愚笨的队员{/#4}低头看着自己沾满虫汁的双手，皮肤上还黏着{#5}{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6}{#9}昆虫甲壳的碎片{/#9}{#10}那些曾经是虫子的甲壳{/#10}{/#5}。他恍然大悟地点点头，转而开始扯甲虫的腿。{#11}学者{/#11}随即骂出了一长串你这辈子都没听过的脏话。{/#1}{#12}你发现{#13}学者{/#13}与{#14}愚笨的队员{/#14}正冲着彼此大吼，两人争得面红耳赤，谁也不肯让步。{#15}愚笨的队员{/#15}说自己根本不在乎是不是笨蛋，{#16}学者{/#16}则坚持每个人都该学点知识。看来{#17}愚笨的队员{/#17}更想按自己的意思过活，他转身便走，只留给{#18}学者{/#18}一个背影。两人的这堂课，大概就此结束了。{/#12}{#19}你发现{#20}愚笨的队员{/#20}蹲在溪边，盯着波光中的自己。他多半已经待了很久，皮肤都有些晒伤了。你问他出了什么事，他说{#21}学者{/#21}教的东西，自己怎么也“弄不明白”；今天{#22}学者{/#22}几乎被逼疯，终于放弃了。你告诉{#23}愚笨的队员{/#23}，他用不着多聪明，会挥剑射箭就行，毕竟你雇他来就是干这个的。他想藏住笑容，溪水中的倒影却出卖了他。你把他带回营地，又让{#24}学者{/#24}暂时别再逼他。{/#19}

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Why will you not learn?!{/#5}{#6}Ignorance is bliss.{/#6}{/#1} (the event ends)

{#1}{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}You come across {#6}Dumbguy{/#6} mulling over a set of coins on a table. You inquire as to what he is doing and he says he's trying to figure out how much to save for retirement. First off, you're surprised he even knows what the word retirement is. Second off, counting? Looks like you might owe {#7}Scholar{/#7} a pint.{/#5}{#8}You find {#9}Dumbguy{/#9} sitting on a stump as he writes across a scroll. When you ask what he's doing, he says he's writing a letter. When you ask to whom it is addressed, the man looks up with a sheepish grin and asks, does it matter? Just then, you spot {#10}Scholar{/#10} in the distance, arms crossed, a look of satisfaction on his face.{/#8}{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}{#5}你看见{#6}愚笨的队员{/#6}正对着桌上一堆硬币苦思冥想。你问他在干什么，他说自己想算算退休得攒多少钱。首先，你很惊讶他居然知道“退休”是什么意思；其次，他竟然开始算数了？看来你该请{#7}学者{/#7}喝杯酒了。{/#5}{#8}你发现{#9}愚笨的队员{/#9}坐在树桩上，正往一卷纸上写字。你问他在做什么，他说在写信。你再问这封信要寄给谁，他抬起头，有些不好意思地咧嘴一笑：“这重要吗？”这时，你看见远处的{#10}学者{/#10}正抱着双臂，满脸欣慰。{/#8}{/#1}

units.source: Reveals available {#1}contracts{/#1} and active {#2}situations{/#2} in the tooltip of settlements no matter where you are
units.zh: 无论你身在何处，都能在聚落的提示框中查看可接取的{#1}委托{/#1}和当前{#2}聚落状况{/#2}。

units.source: Have 90 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Relations{/#4} (allied) with a noble house or city state
Has a 25% chance of not consuming crafting components used by you
units.zh: 制作物品时，有 25% 的概率不消耗所用的制作材料。

units.source: Unlocks {#1}Snake Oil{/#1} recipe to earn money by crafting from various low tier components
units.zh: 解锁{#1}蛇油{/#1}配方，可将各种低级材料制成蛇油出售赚钱。

units.source: Repairs all {#1}Body Armor{/#1}, {#2}Headgear{/#2}, {#3}Weapons{/#3} and {#4}Shields{/#4} worn by your men even if they're broken or lost because your man died
units.zh: 修复队员穿戴的所有{#1}身体护甲{/#1}、{#2}头部装备{/#2}、{#3}武器{/#3}和{#4}盾牌{/#4}；即使装备已经损毁，或因队员阵亡而丢失，也能保留下来。

units.source: Repair 5 items at the smith in a settlement (Alt Key + Right Mouse Button at the Weaponsmith or Armorer)
units.zh: 在聚落的铁匠处修理 5 件物品；在武器铺或铠甲铺按住 Alt 键并用鼠标右键点击物品即可。

units.source: Pays you between 100 and 400 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} for every location you discover on your own. The further away from civilization, the more you're paid. {#4}Legendary Locations{/#4} pay double.
units.zh: 每当你自行发现一处地点，就会获得 100 至 400 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}。地点越远离文明地区，报酬越高；{#4}传奇地点{/#4}的报酬翻倍。

units.source: Makes men in reserve never lose {#1}Mood{/#1} from not taking part in battles
units.zh: 预备队成员不会再因未能参战而降低{#1}心情{/#1}。

units.source: Makes {#1}Tavern Rumors{/#1} more likely to contain useful information
units.zh: 提高{#1}酒馆传闻{/#1}包含有用情报的概率。

units.source: The {#1}Tavern Rumors{/#1} will only contain {#2}Contract Rumors{/#2}, {#3}Location Rumors{/#3} and {#4}Named Item Rumors{/#4}
Allows for more rounds of {#1}Contract{/#1} negotiations with your potential employers before they abort, and without any hit to {#2}Relations{/#2}
units.zh: 与潜在雇主商谈{#1}委托{/#1}时，可以在对方终止谈判前多议价几轮，且不会损害{#2}关系{/#2}。

units.source: Makes good {#1}Relations{/#1} with any faction decay slower and bad {#2}Relations{/#2} recover faster by {#3}15%{/#3}
units.zh: 与各势力的良好{#1}关系{/#1}衰减得更慢，恶劣{#2}关系{/#2}恢复得更快，两项改善幅度均为 {#3}15%{/#3}。

units.source: You are 50% less likely to fail a negotiation for better payment
units.zh: 要求提高报酬时，谈判失败的概率降低 50%。

units.source: You are 25% less likely to fail a negotiation for payment in advance
units.zh: 要求预付款时，谈判失败的概率降低 25%。

units.source: {#1}Greedy Demands Raise{/#1}, {#2}Noble More Pay Lowborn{/#2}, {#3}Player Is Rich{/#3} and {#4}Sellsword Gets Better Deal{/#4}
units.zh: {#1}贪婪佣兵要求加薪{/#1}、{#2}贵族不满薪酬低于平民{/#2}、{#3}富裕的团长{/#3}和{#4}佣兵谋求更好待遇{/#4}。

units.source: Increases the amount of {#1}Ammunition{/#1} you can carry by 100
units.zh: 可携带的{#1}弹药{/#1}上限增加 100。

units.source: Increases the amount of {#1}Medical Supplies{/#1} and {#2}Tools and Supplies{/#2} you can carry by 50 each
units.zh: 可携带的{#1}医疗物资{/#1}和{#2}工具与修缮物资{/#2}上限各增加 50。

units.source: Recovers {#1}Tools and Supplies{/#1} from every armor destroyed by you during battle
units.zh: 战斗中，每摧毁一件护甲，都能从中回收{#1}工具与修缮物资{/#1}。

units.source: Only fully destroyed (not just damaged) enemy body armor and helmets are eligible for tools recovery.
units.zh: 只有被彻底摧毁的敌方身甲和头盔才能回收工具，仅仅受损的装备不算。

units.source: Recovers up to 15% of tools needed to repair destroyed armor, capped at 60 tools. The actual amount recovered can be as low as half of that. In other words, the number of tools recovered is equal to 0.5-1% of maximum durability of destroyed enemy armor.
units.zh: 最多可回收相当于修复被摧毁的护甲所需工具量 15% 的工具，最多 60 个。实际回收量最低可能只有上述数量的一半。换算下来，回收的工具数量等于被摧毁敌方护甲最大耐久的 0.5-1%。

units.source: {#1}Desert Bugbite{/#1}, {#2}Desert Fall{/#2}, {#3}Desert Feet{/#3}, {#4}Desert Heat{/#4}, {#5}Desert Sand{/#5}, {#6}Mountains Are Dangerous{/#6} and {#7}Sickness{/#7}
Makes every man without a {#1}Permanent Injury{/#1} guaranteed to survive an otherwise fatal blow
units.zh: 任何没有{#1}永久伤势{/#1}的队员，都必定能从原本致命的一击中幸存。

units.source: Makes every {#1}Injury{/#1} take one less day to heal
units.zh: 所有{#1}伤势{/#1}的恢复时间缩短一天。

units.source: Increases the amount of {#1}Trade Goods{/#1} for sale by 1 for each location that produces them, like salt near salt mines, allowing you to trade at higher volumes
units.zh: 每处贸易商品产地都会使相应{#1}贸易商品{/#1}的出售数量增加 1。例如，盐矿附近会多出售盐，方便你扩大贸易规模。

units.source: Retinue is a gameplay mechanic introduced with the {#1}Blazing Deserts DLC{/#1}.{#2/}
units.zh: 随行人员是{#1}《烈日沙漠》DLC{/#1}引入的玩法机制。{#2/}

units.source: Here you can see your retinue of non-combat followers that grant various advantages outside combat and upgrade your cart for more inventory space.
units.zh: 在这个界面，你可以管理不参与战斗的随行人员；他们会提供各种战斗外的加成。你也可以升级货车，扩充物品栏。

units.source: Free inventory slots - sometimes one is enough - are required to complete some {#1}ambitions{/#1} or trigger certain {#2}events{/#2}.
units.zh: 部分{#1}战团抱负{/#1}的完成或某些{#2}事件{/#2}的触发，需要物品栏中留有空位；有时只需一个空位。

units.source: {#1}This is your donkey. You start with 99 inventory slots. More or less depending on the chosen {#2}Origin{/#2}.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这是你的驴。初始物品栏通常有 99 格，具体容量会因所选{#2}开局起源{/#2}而有所增减。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}You can choose to buy a cart in order to gain 27 more inventory slots.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}你可以购买一辆小货车，使物品栏增加 27 格。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}You can choose to buy a wagon in order to gain 27 more inventory slots.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}你可以购买一辆货车，使物品栏再增加 27 格。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}You can choose to buy a big wagon in order to gain 27 more inventory slots.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}你可以购买一辆大货车，使物品栏再增加 27 格。{/#1}

units.source: Follower slots are unlocked when you reach a certain {#1}Renown{/#1} level.
units.zh: 达到相应的{#1}声望{/#1}等级后，会解锁更多随行人员位置。

units.source: {#1}This article can be {#2}improved{/#2}{/#1}:{#3/}Add icons (for status effects, skills), apply font color (green for positive effect values, red for negative), add links (for status effects, skills, game mechanics).
units.zh: {#1}本条目仍可{#2}完善{/#2}{/#1}：{#3/}补充状态效果与技能图标，以绿色标示有利数值、红色标示不利数值，并添加状态效果、技能和游戏机制的相关链接。

units.source: {#1}Hint{/#1}: To expand all Potion Effects content, try the solution from this {#2}comment{/#2}.
units.zh: {#1}提示{/#1}：若想展开所有药剂效果，可尝试{#2}这条评论{/#2}中介绍的方法。

units.source: Take between 25% and 50% less damage from piercing attacks, such as those from bows or spears
units.zh: 受到弓、矛等穿刺攻击时，伤害降低 25% 至 50%。

units.source: Take 50% less hp damage from bows, crossbow, slings, handgonnes, javelins and the ignite firelance skill.
units.zh: 弓、弩、投石索、手铳、标枪及火矛的点火技能造成的生命值伤害降低 50%。

units.source: Take 25% less hp damage from daggers, spears, swords, pikes.
units.zh: 匕首、矛、剑及长枪造成的生命值伤害降低 25%。

units.source: Seems that for multi-attack skills you need to miss all attacks.
units.zh: 对于包含多次攻击的技能，似乎必须所有攻击都未命中才会触发。

units.source: Accumulate no {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Fatigue from enemy attacks, whether they hit or miss
units.zh: 遭到敌人攻击时，无论对方命中还是落空，都不会因此积累{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}疲劳。

units.source: Rotation and Footwork cost half {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} fatigue and 1 less {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} AP
Works for all effects that use the "Break Free" skill, so Kraken Tentancle grapple, Nets, Webs, Roots.
units.zh: 对所有需要使用“挣脱”技能解除的效果都有效，包括克拉肯触手的缠绕、捕网、蛛网及树根。

units.source: It won't work if potioned brother tries to help free someone else, but it WILL work if someone else tries to break free the potioned brother.
units.zh: 服药的队员帮助别人挣脱时，这项效果不生效；但别人帮助服药的队员挣脱时，效果会生效。

units.source: Works against Charm, Chilled, Hex, Bleeding, Dazed, Disarmed, Distracted, Horrified, Insect Swarm, Lindwurm Acid, Overwhelm, Shellshocked, Sleep, Staggered, Stunned, Withered.
units.zh: 对魅惑、冻寒、咒缚、流血、恍惚、被缴械、分心、惊恐、虫群、林德蠕龙酸液、压制、炮击震荡、沉睡、踉跄、眩晕及凋萎有效。

units.source: Causes{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}Hitpoints damage to make melee attackers suffer the Lindwurm acid effect
units.zh: 近战攻击者若对服药者造成{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}生命值伤害，就会受到林德蠕龙酸液效果影响。

units.source: Works just like the surgeons bonus, and stacks with it.
units.zh: 效果与外科医生提供的加成相同，并且可以与其叠加。

units.source: Heal for 25% of{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}Hitpoints damage inflicited against adjacent enemies that have blood
units.zh: 对相邻且有血液的敌人造成{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}生命值伤害时，回复相当于该伤害 25% 的生命值。

units.source: Need to be adjacent to enemy, enemy must not be immune to {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}bleeding.
units.zh: 目标必须与服药者相邻，而且不能免疫{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}流血。

units.source: The buff is functionally the same as the berserkers rage passive, except that you can only gain stacks by taking {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}Hitpoints damage, and gain 3 stacks each time, up to a cap of 15, losing 1 at turn end.
units.zh: 这项增益的机制与狂战士的狂战之怒被动相同，但只能通过受到{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}生命值伤害叠层。每次增加 3 层，上限为 15 层，每回合结束时失去 1 层。

units.source: Each stack reduces damage taken by 2%, increases resolve, initiative and damage by 1.
units.zh: 每层使所受伤害降低 2%，并使意志、先攻和伤害各增加 1。

units.source: Works for orc weapons and shields, but only applies to skill use and not the increased base weight of them.
units.zh: 对兽人武器和盾牌有效，但只影响使用技能时的额外消耗，不会减轻这些装备本身较高的基础负重。

units.source: With named variants, if they roll reduced {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}Fatigue on skill use, these benefits won't stack. It's just going to be a fixed 0.
units.zh: 如果名贵版本已经随机获得降低技能{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}疲劳消耗的词条，两种效果不会叠加；额外疲劳消耗只会固定为 0。

units.source: 33% chance to resist {#1}Dazed{/#1}, {#2}Staggered{/#2}, {#3}Stunned{/#3}, {#4}Distracted{/#4} and Withered effects
It's a flat +10% bonus, i.e. a warhammer will go from 225% armor damage to 235%.
units.zh: 这是直接相加的 +10% 加成。例如，战锤的护甲伤害系数会从 225% 提升至 235%。

units.source: Deal +25% damage and take only 75% damage when{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}Hitpoints is below 50%
Seems this will be doubled by Backstabber for +16% to hit per ally, and Underdog is a flat -5%, meaning Backstabber and pot vs Underdog is still +11%.
units.zh: 原文推测，背刺者会将该效果翻倍，使每名友军提供 +16% 命中；以少敌多则固定施加 -5% 修正，因此背刺者与药剂同时生效、对上以少敌多时，仍有 +11% 加成。

units.source: This results in the brother needing to take 33.25% of max hp to suffer a light injury and 66.5% to suffer a heavy injury.
units.zh: 因此，队员必须受到相当于最大生命值 33.25% 的伤害才会遭受轻伤，受到 66.5% 才会遭受重伤。

units.source: Stacks with Ironjaw Trait for a 66.25% increased threshold, meaning you'd need to take 41% of max hp for a light injury and 83% for a heavy injury.
units.zh: 可与铁下巴特性叠加，使受伤阈值提高 66.25%；此时，需要受到相当于最大生命值 41% 的伤害才会遭受轻伤，受到 83% 才会遭受重伤。

units.source: Covers 7 tiles in smoke for one round, allowing anyone inside to move freely and ignore zones of control
units.zh: 烟雾覆盖 7 个地块，持续一轮；区域内的所有单位均可自由移动，无视控制区域。

units.source: In every battle completely absorbs the damage (status effects and fatigue still apply) of a first hit that doesn't completely ignore armor (e.g. doesn't work against daggers' puncture), {#1}−2{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}
units.zh: 每场战斗中，完全吸收首次非完全无视护甲攻击的伤害；状态效果和疲劳仍会生效。匕首的穿刺等完全无视护甲的攻击不在防护范围内。疲劳上限 {#1}−2{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}

units.source: Reduces the Resolve of any opponent engaged in melee by {#1}−5{/#1}, {#2}+15{/#2}{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}
Gain {#1}+20{/#1} {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} Resolve at morale checks against fear, panic or mind control effects

{#1/}The 'Beasts & Exploration' DLC added crafting as a core game mechanic.{#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}1{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2} Before that, crafting was accomplished through {#6}events{/#6}. The new system incorporates the old {#7}Tailor{/#7} {#8}event{/#8} which has been removed from the game in favor of a new recipe. Crafting is mostly conducted at the {#9}taxidermist{/#9}.
units.zh: {#1/}《野兽与探索》DLC 将制作系统加入游戏，成为核心机制之一。{#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}1{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2}此前，制作物品主要通过{#6}事件{/#6}完成。新系统吸收了原先{#7}裁缝{/#7}{#8}事件{/#8}的内容，该事件随后被移除，改由新的制作配方替代。制作主要在{#9}剥制工坊{/#9}进行。

units.source: To successfully craft an item, certain ingredients and a certain amount of Crowns are necessary. Recipes are automatically displayed if the necessary requirements are met or once they've been used. Some ingredients and even items (paint) can be bought or found in locations. Most components however are looted on dead monsters, primarily beasts ({#1}trophies{/#1}). Higher value items usually require rare ingredients and more Crowns to craft.
units.zh: 制作物品需要指定材料和一定数量的克朗。满足所需条件，或曾使用过某个配方后，该配方便会自动显示。有些材料乃至成品（例如涂料）可以购买，或在各处地点找到；不过，大多数材料来自击杀怪物后的战利品，尤其是野兽的{#1}战利品{/#1}。价值较高的物品通常需要更稀有的材料和更多克朗。

units.source: ({#1}Hint{/#1}: The component name can be searched (Ctrl + F shortcut), and will show up as a text over the ingredient icon. Positioning mouse cursor over an ingredient, till its shape is changed to a sword, will provide the same information and also opponent's name in parentheses. The {#2}trophies{/#2} page has a similar feature, which allows opening an opponent or a crafted item page upon clicking a corresponding icon.)
units.zh: （{#1}提示{/#1}：可用 Ctrl + F 搜索材料名称；名称以文本形式附在材料图标处。将鼠标移到材料上，直到光标变成剑形，也能看到同样的信息，以及括号内的敌人名称。{#2}战利品{/#2}页面有类似功能，点击对应图标可打开敌人或制作成品的条目。）

units.source: Reduces the target's armor by {#1}20%{/#1} each turn for 3 turns
units.zh: 持续 3 回合，每回合使目标护甲降低 {#1}20%{/#1}。

units.source: Removes the Poisoned status effect, grants immunity to any Poison for 3 turns
units.zh: 移除中毒状态，并在 3 回合内免疫所有毒素。

units.source: Anyone ending their turn inside the burning area will catch fire and take damage - friend and foe alike
units.zh: 任何在燃烧区域内结束回合的单位都会着火并受到伤害，敌我皆不例外。

units.source: Will give up to 7 targets the Dazed status effect for 2 turns
units.zh: 使最多 7 个目标陷入恍惚，持续 2 回合。

units.source: The next 4 attacks will apply the Poisoned status effect for {#1}10{/#1} damage per turn
units.zh: 接下来的 4 次攻击会附加中毒状态，每回合造成 {#1}10{/#1} 点伤害。

units.source: Not affected by non-permanent injuries for the duration of 1 battle
units.zh: 在接下来的 1 场战斗中，不受非永久伤势的影响。

units.source: Poisoned Apple Unhold's Heart Nachzehrer Brain Poison Gland Heart of the Forest Petrified Scream Severed Tentacle
units.zh: 毒苹果、巨魔之心、食尸鬼脑髓、毒腺、森林之心、凝固的尖啸、断落的触手

units.source: Black Paint White, Green and Yellow Paint Orange and Red Paint
units.zh: 黑色涂料；白色、绿色与黄色涂料；橙色与红色涂料

units.source: Can only be sold for 650 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}. The {#4}follower Alchemist{/#4} is needed to craft it.
Damage of {#1}20{/#1} for 3 turns to any undead target hit
units.zh: 命中亡灵目标后，每回合造成 {#1}20{/#1} 点伤害，持续 3 回合。

units.source: This pages lists some bugs (and mechanics) that were present in the game version 1.4.0.49. Some bugs can still be present in the latest 1.5.0.15 version.
units.zh: 本页记录游戏 1.4.0.49 版本曾存在的一些漏洞及机制；其中部分问题在原文所述的 1.5.0.15 版本中可能依然存在。版本说明仅反映原文写作时的情况。

units.source: {#1}NOTE{/#1}: if you edit, add or remove any game bug, provide a link to the {#2}official game developer forum{/#2} - as a proof - in the text. Any streamer with fine reputation can add a link to his video with a timecode. And don't forget that the wiki is dedicated to the unmodded, vanilla game.
units.zh: {#1}注意{/#1}：在原站编辑、添加或移除漏洞条目时，应在正文中附上{#2}游戏开发者官方论坛{/#2}的相关链接作为依据。信誉良好的主播也可提供带时间点的视频链接。请记住，这个 Wiki 讨论的是未安装 MOD 的原版游戏。

units.source: Dropping an arrows or bolts quiver or powder bag from a BAG SLOT makes the item completely disappear: the item is not lying on the ground, nor at the loot screen at the end of the battle.
units.zh: 从背包栏丢弃箭袋、弩矢袋或火药袋，会让物品彻底消失：地面上找不到，战斗结束后的战利品界面中也没有。

units.source: {#1}Workaround:{/#1} Dropping a quiver or powder bag from a bag slot on the ground while another item is already lying doesn't proc the bug. {#2}OR{/#2} Dropping a quiver or powder bag from the special quiver slot works as expected: the item is on the ground, and can also be looted after the battle.
units.zh: {#1}临时解决办法：{/#1}若地上已经有其他物品，再从背包栏丢弃箭袋或火药袋，就不会触发该漏洞。{#2}或者{/#2}，从专用弹药栏丢弃箭袋或火药袋；此时物品会正常落地，战后也能拾取。

units.source: Dropping a Throwing Spear from a BAG SLOT to the ground makes the item completely disappear: the item is not lying on the ground, nor at the loot screen at the end of the battle. {#1}OR{/#1} Swapping a Throwing Spear from a BAG SLOT to an item on the ground, i.e. picking up a lootable item and dropping the spear in one move, makes the Throwing Spear disappear.
units.zh: 从背包栏把投矛丢到地上，会让它彻底消失：地面和战后战利品界面中都找不到。{#1}另一种触发方式是{/#1}，把背包栏的投矛与地上的物品交换，也就是在同一次操作中拾取地面物品并丢下投矛；投矛同样会消失。

units.source: {#1}Workaround:{/#1} Equip the Throwing Spear to an active slot (right hand), then drop it to the ground.
units.zh: {#1}临时解决办法：{/#1}先把投矛装备到当前使用的武器栏（右手），再将其丢到地上。

units.source: Freshly released dogs don't have any Action Points to move or attack. Can occur in early and mid-round, but more 'often' at the end of the round. Rarity: rare.
units.zh: 刚放出的战犬没有行动点，无法移动或攻击。回合初期和中期都可能发生，但在回合末更常见。发生频率：罕见。

units.source: Freshly released dogs in an adjacent tile don't reveal opponents hiding in the tall grass.
units.zh: 放到相邻格的战犬，不会揭示藏在高草中的敌人。

units.source: Freshly released dogs don't proc morale (drop) check if deployed in ZOC of an opponent.
units.zh: 在敌人的控制区内放出战犬，不会触发该敌人的士气下降检定。

units.source: Equipped Hounds (or Hound collars) can be dropped to the ground just like other items. The Hounds then can be 'looted' after battle. To perform the glitch: Swap a lying on the ground necklace (which can simply be put to a bag slot) to a Hound or a Hound collar from the accessory slot. After the battle, the Hounds can be 'looted'; Falcon or Falcon feather can be used instead of the necklace for the same purpose.
units.zh: 已装备的战犬或项圈也能像普通物品一样被丢到地上，并在战后作为“战利品”拾取。触发方法是：把地上的项链与饰品栏里的战犬或项圈交换；项链可事先从背包放到地上。战斗结束后即可“拾取”战犬。猎隼或猎隼羽毛也可替代项链，用于同样的操作。

units.source: Killed Fallen Heroes 'drop' helmets as an item during combat. Rarity: rare.
units.zh: 阵亡英雄被击杀后，有时会在战斗中把头盔作为物品“掉落”在地上。发生频率：罕见。

units.source: Warscythe and Rhomphaia balloon tooltips erroneously show 104% effective vs armor, while the real armor damage value is 105%. (this bug was previously fixed in the initial Blazing Deserts DLC update, but later it got 're-introduced')
units.zh: 战镰和镰刃长剑的悬浮提示错误地显示护甲伤害为 104%，实际数值是 105%。此问题曾在《烈日沙漠》DLC 首次更新时修复，后来又再次出现。

units.source: Using Rotation skill (and similar one by Barbarians) to swap out a unit in opponent's ZOC counts towards morale check drop, just like as being engaged by 2+ opponents in during the same turn, while actually only 1 opponent is actually engaged. (~bug/mechanic)
units.zh: 用换位技能或野蛮人的类似技能，把位于敌方控制区内的单位换出来时，也会计入士气下降检定。这相当于同一回合内遭到 2+ 名敌人接战，尽管实际上接战的只有 1 名敌人。（可能属于漏洞，也可能是机制。）

units.source: Fleeing hexen and alps don't actually flee, because their AI has no "flee" behavior. They make horrified sounds just like other enemies, but stand still doing nothing, and alps also won't teleport. You need to stand near them and not sleep to prevent rallying due to their high resolve.
units.zh: 进入溃逃状态的女巫和梦魇实际上不会逃跑，因为它们的 AI 没有逃跑行为。它们会像其他敌人一样发出惊恐的声音，却只是站在原地不动；梦魇也不会传送。由于它们意志很高，你需要让队员保持清醒并站在旁边，阻止它们重振士气。
